zh: 共同基线把两组日期连成一条
en: One baseline holds two date groups together
dz: 年份降为基线下的辅助字，月日成为主线。
de: Years drop below the shared baseline; month and day keep the line.
pz: 两组数字各占一段，靠同一条基线对齐；重复的年份缩小压到基线下方，读者先看变化的月日。
pe: Two number groups sit on one shared baseline. The repeating year shrinks below it so the changing month and day read first.

caption.zh: 两组日期共用一条基线
caption.en: Two date groups on one baseline

observation.zh: 同一张画面里，12/30 和 05/31 是主角，2017 和 2018 被压到很小；四组数字的下缘落在同一条水平线上，缩小的年份就贴在这条线下面。
observation.en: In one frame 12/30 and 05/31 carry the size while 2017 and 2018 shrink almost to nothing. All four sit on one horizontal line, and the shrunken years tuck just below it.

zh: 先按原样写出完整区间，例如 2017.12/30-2018.05/31，所有数字同号同大小。
找出两组里重复出现的部分，通常是年份。
把重复部分缩到主数字的 30% 到 40%，下缘压到同一条基线下。
去掉小年份只读月日，如果读不懂，说明降级过头。
en: Write the range out in full first, e.g. 2017.12/30-2018.05/31, with every digit at one size.
Find the part the two groups repeat, usually the year.
Shrink that part to 30-40% of the main figures and drop its lower edge onto the same baseline.
Read the months and days alone: if they no longer make sense, the year was demoted too far.

exercise.zh: 拿一组两组对比的数据，两个日期、两个价格或两个指标，把重复的量纲或年份降到基线下方，只留变化的部分做大字。
exercise.en: Take any pair of comparable values, two dates, two prices or two metrics, demote the repeated unit below the baseline and keep only the changing part large.

zh: 两组数字的下缘是否严格落在同一条线上
缩小的年份是否还能一眼看出属于哪一组
主数字与降级字之间是否明显差一档字号
en: Do the lower edges of both groups land on exactly one line?
Can you still tell at a glance which group each shrunken year belongs to?
Is there a clear one-step size gap between the main figures and the demoted ones?

caution.zh: 降级的字不能小到读不出来，也不能和主数字抢同一档字号，它必须明显低一档。
caution.en: The demoted text must not shrink past legibility, and it must not sit in the same size step as the main figures. It needs a clearly lower step.

prompt.zh: 请排一张只有一组日期区间的版式：主数字 12/30 与 05/31 使用同一字号、同一条基线；重复出现的年份缩到主数字的三分之一，紧贴这条基线的下方；两组之间留一个字宽的间隔。只用黑白两色，不要任何装饰。
prompt.en: Build a layout around a single date range. Set 12/30 and 05/31 at the same size on one shared baseline. Shrink the repeated years to a third of that size and tuck them just under the same baseline. Leave one character width between the two groups. Black on off-white only, no ornament.

zh: 两组宽度按黄金比切分
en: Split the two groups at the golden ratio
dz: 左右两段的宽度比约 1 比 0.618。
de: The left and right spans run about 1 to 0.618.
pz: 左右两组之间有一条竖线，从左边框到这条线是一段，从这条线到右边框是另一段，两段长度比约为 1 比 0.618。
pe: A vertical rule stands between the two groups. The span from the left margin to the rule and from the rule to the right margin measure roughly 1 to 0.618.

caption.zh: 两组宽度按黄金比切分
caption.en: The two groups split at the golden ratio

observation.zh: 画面被一条竖线分成两段，左边一段明显长于右边；标注写着 X 与 0.618X，也就是两段长度比约 1 比 0.618。
observation.en: One vertical rule cuts the page into two spans. The left one runs visibly longer than the right, and the labels read X and 0.618X, a ratio of about 1 to 0.618.

zh: 量出左边界到右边界的整段宽度。
按 1 比 0.618 把整段切成两段，切点就是两组内容的分界位置。
在切点画一条贯通的细竖线，两组内容各自在自己那段里取齐。
内容撑不下时先调字号或换行，不要挪动这条分界线。
en: Measure the full width from the left margin to the right margin.
Cut that span at 1 to 0.618; the cut point is where the two groups divide.
Draw a thin rule at the cut, full height of the text block, and set each group flush inside its own span.
If content will not fit, change size or wrap the line. Never move the rule.

exercise.zh: 用一条竖线把版心按 1 比 0.618 分成两栏，左栏放一组数字，右栏放另一组，检查两栏是否都站得住。
exercise.en: Divide the text area at 1 to 0.618 with one vertical rule, put a group of figures in each span, and check that both hold without stretching.

zh: 竖线是否把整段切成约 1 比 0.618
竖线是否贯穿文字块的高度而不是悬空一小段
两组内容是否各自在自己那段里取齐
en: Does the rule cut the span at roughly 1 to 0.618?
Does it run the full height of the text block instead of floating mid-air?
Does each group align inside its own span rather than drifting toward the rule?

caution.zh: 比例先定，内容再迁就比例。为了塞内容把线挪走，这张版就散了。
caution.en: Fix the ratio first and let the content follow it. Move the rule to fit the copy and the layout falls apart.

prompt.zh: 请做一张左右分组的信息版式：把版心宽度按 1 比 0.618 分成两段，分界处画一条贯穿版心的细竖线；左段放 12/30，右段放 05/31，两组同字号，各自在自己那段里左对齐。黑白灰，不加图片。
prompt.en: Design a two-group information layout. Divide the text area at 1 to 0.618 and draw a thin rule through the full height at the division. Put 12/30 in the left span and 05/31 in the right, same size, each flush left inside its own span. Black, white and grey only, no imagery.

zh: 用引线把副行撑满主字宽度
en: Dashes stretch the sub-line to the main width
dz: 破折号当引线，让副行两端与主字两端重合。
de: Em dashes act as leaders so the sub-line matches the figure above.
pz: 主数字 12.30 下面一行小字，靠两根破折号把字距拉开，左右两端正好抵住主数字的左右边界，上下两行齐头齐尾。
pe: Under the main figure 12.30 runs a small line. Two em dashes spread it so its ends land exactly on the left and right edges of the figure above, making the two rows flush at both ends.

caption.zh: 副行用引线撑满主字宽度
caption.en: Dashes stretch the sub-line to the main width

observation.zh: 12.30 下面写着 2017——六——Saturday，左右两端正好压在主数字的两条边界线上，靠两根破折号把空隙填满。
observation.en: Beneath 12.30 sits the line 2017——六——Saturday. Its two ends land on the boundary lines of the figure above, with em dashes filling the gaps.

zh: 先定主数字字号，量出它的左右边界。
把副行拆成几个信息单元，例如年、中文星期、英文星期。
在单元之间插入破折号，增减数量直到副行两端与主数字两端重合。
副行字号取主数字的 25% 到 33%，与主数字保持固定距离。
en: Set the main figure's size and measure its left and right edges.
Break the sub-line into units, for example year, weekday character, weekday name.
Insert em dashes between units and add or remove them until the sub-line's ends meet the figure's ends.
Keep the sub-line at 25-33% of the main size and at a fixed distance below it.

exercise.zh: 写一行主标题和三个从属信息，用破折号把从属信息撑到与主标题完全等宽。
exercise.en: Write one main headline and three pieces of supporting information, then use dashes to stretch the supporting line to exactly the headline's width.

zh: 副行两端是否与主行两端对齐
几根破折号的长度与间隔是否一致
副行是否始终保持同一档小字号
en: Do the two ends of the sub-line align with the two ends of the main line?
Do the dashes share one length and one spacing?
Does the sub-line stay at a single small size throughout?

caution.zh: 破折号只负责撑宽，不要拿它当装饰。两端对不齐就调数量或字距，不要把字拉变形。
caution.en: The dashes exist to fill width, not to decorate. If the ends miss, change their count or the tracking. Never stretch the glyphs.

prompt.zh: 请排一组两行文字：上行是超大数字 12.30，下行是小字 2017 —— 六 —— Saturday。用两根破折号把下行撑到与上行左右完全等宽，两行左端右端都对齐。浅灰底，纯黑文字。
prompt.en: Set two lines. The top line is the oversized figure 12.30; the bottom line is small text reading 2017 —— 六 —— Saturday. Use two em dashes to stretch the bottom line until both its ends align exactly with the top line's ends. Off-white ground, solid black type.

zh: 字形当窗口，一幅图案贯穿全词
en: Letters as a window: one pattern runs through the word
dz: 图案只在整词上铺一次，由字的轮廓裁切出来。
de: The pattern is laid down once across the whole word and the letterforms crop it.
pz: 各字里的条纹、星点相位必须彼此对得上；一旦对不上，一眼就看出是逐字各贴了一份。
pe: The stripes and stars have to hold one phase from letter to letter. The moment they do not line up, the fill reads as decoration pasted into each letter.

caption.zh: 一套图案裁出一整行字
caption.en: One pattern crops a whole line of type

observation.zh: 旗面上的红色横带在 YANKEE DOODLE 每个字母里都停在同一个高度，星点也顺着字母一路排下去，中间不断。字不是各自填色，而是整幅图案被字裁开。
observation.en: The red band of the flag stops at the same height inside every letter of the word, and the stars keep marching across letter after letter without a break. Nothing was filled letter by letter; one graphic was cropped by the type.

zh: 先排好整行字，确定字号、字距与字重，先不要填色。
在整个词的范围上画一个跨全长的图案，例如一条横带加分界带。
把字的轮廓做成裁切路径，用图案去裁这行字。
放大到逐字检查分界线：任意两个相邻字母的图案相位必须对得上。
en: Set the whole line first, size and spacing and weight, with no fill.
Draw one graphic that spans the full width of the word, a band plus a divider band, say.
Turn the letterforms into a clipping path and crop the graphic with them.
Zoom in letter by letter on the divider: the pattern phase must match between any two neighbours.

exercise.zh: 拿一个四到六个字母的短词，用一条斜向分界把词面分成上下两片不同的图案，检查每个字母的分界是否落在同一条斜线上。
exercise.en: Take a short word of four to six letters and split it with one diagonal into two different fills, then check that the split lands on the same diagonal inside every letter.

zh: 相邻字母的图案相位是否连续，中间有没有重新起头
图案的切割线是否是一条贯穿全词的直线或曲线
去掉填充只留轮廓时，这行字本身是否还站得住
en: Does the pattern stay continuous between neighbours instead of restarting?
Is the cutting line one line or curve running right through the word?
With the fill removed, does the line of type still hold up as letterforms?

caution.zh: 相位对不上是最常见的失败：每个字各贴一份，看着热闹，实际上把一个词拆成了互不相干的几块。图案越密，相位错位越刺眼。
caution.en: Lost phase is the usual failure: every letter gets its own copy, which looks busy and quietly breaks the word into unrelated pieces. The denser the pattern, the louder the misalignment.

prompt.zh: 请把单词 SAFARI 排成一行粗体大写，两侧留出半个字母宽的边距。在整个词上画一幅贯穿全宽的图案：上半是一条实色横带，下半是等距圆点，上下各占一半，分界线水平。用字母轮廓裁切这幅图案，使分界线和圆点的相位在所有字母里完全连续，不允许每个字母各起一份。背景单色，不加阴影、描边和渐变。
prompt.en: Set the word SAFARI as one line of heavy capitals with half a letter width of margin at each end. Draw a single graphic across the whole word: a solid band on top, evenly spaced dots below, one half each, split on a level line. Crop that graphic with the letterforms so both the split and the dot phase run unbroken through every letter, never restarting per letter. One flat background colour, no shadow, no outline, no gradient.

zh: 内线字：笔画里嵌一条细线
en: Inline: one hairline runs inside the stroke
dz: 粗笔画沿中心轴留一条背景色的细线，字立刻透气。
de: A heavy stroke keeps one line of the ground showing along its centre, and the letter breathes again.
pz: 笔画照常填色，只沿中心轴留一条背景色的细线，两端各留一小段不切通。字越粗，这条线救回的呼吸越多。
pe: Fill the stroke as usual but leave one line of background along its centre axis, stopping short of both ends. The heavier the face, the more that line gives back.

caption.zh: 同一条笔画，实心与内线
caption.en: One stroke, solid and inlined

observation.zh: MOUSE IN MANHATTAN 的字面全是极粗的等线大写，可是每一笔的正中都走了一条细线，线两端不到边。笔画因此少了将近三分之一的黑，字腔没有被堵死，在暗底上还多出一道发光感。
observation.en: The capitals are about as heavy as a monoline face gets, yet a hairline runs down the middle of every stroke and stops short of both terminals. The stroke loses nearly a third of its black, the counters stay open, and on a dark ground the line reads as a glow.

zh: 先把这行字排成实心粗体，确认粗到有点闷。
在每一笔的正中画出中心轴。
沿中心轴挖一条等宽的线，线宽约为笔画宽度的六分之一到四分之一。
线的两端各内缩一小段，不要切穿笔画的起笔与收笔。
缩到阅读尺寸再看：如果细线糊成灰调而不是一条线，说明笔画还不够粗。
en: Set the line solid and heavy first, heavy enough to feel stuffy.
Find the centre axis of every stroke.
Cut a line of even width along that axis, about a sixth to a quarter of the stroke width.
Inset both ends of the line a little so it never breaks through the terminals.
Shrink to reading size: if the line smears into grey instead of holding as a line, the stroke was not heavy enough.

exercise.zh: 用同一个词排两行，一行实心一行内线，字号与字距完全一致，然后缩到只有原来十分之一大，看两行里哪一行还是一个字，哪一行已经变成灰块。
exercise.en: Set the same word twice at identical size and spacing, one solid and one inlined, then shrink it to a tenth. See which one still reads as a word and which has gone to a grey slab.

zh: 细线是否始终走在笔画正中，没有偏向一侧
线的两端是否内缩，没有把笔画切断
细线的线宽是否处处一致
en: Does the line stay on the centre axis instead of drifting to one side?
Are both ends inset, so the stroke is never cut through?
Is the line one constant width everywhere?

caution.zh: 笔画不够粗时不要用内线，细线会把笔画切成两条更细的线，字反而更弱。内线是给超粗字减重的，不是给中等字加装饰的。
caution.en: Do not inline a stroke that is not already heavy: the line splits it into two thinner strokes and the letter gets weaker. Inline is a way to lighten an over-heavy face, not a decoration for a medium one.

prompt.zh: 请排一行超粗等线大写标题，字重接近方块。每一笔沿中心轴挖出一条等宽细线，线宽为笔画宽度的五分之一，两端各内缩笔画宽度的一半，绝不切穿起笔和收笔。细线用背景色，整图只有深底和字两个颜色，不要描边、阴影和渐变。
prompt.en: Set one line of extremely heavy monolinear capitals, close to a slab in weight. Cut an even line along the centre axis of every stroke, a fifth of the stroke width, inset at both ends by half the stroke width so no terminal is ever broken. The line is the background colour. Two colours in the whole image, type and ground, with no outline, shadow or gradient.

zh: 大字号改空心，线宽与线图同值
en: Hollow type: stroke weight matched to the line art
dz: 大标题只描边不填色，描边粗细取画面线图的线宽。
de: A huge title is drawn as an outline only, at the same weight as the lines of the drawing.
pz: 字号一大，实心字就把插画压死；改成空心，并把描边粗细调成与线稿完全同一个值，字与图才落在同一层上。
pe: At display size a solid fill flattens the illustration. Switch the type to an outline and set its weight to exactly the drawing's line weight, and type and art sit on one layer.

caption.zh: 空心大字与线稿共用一个线宽
caption.en: Hollow display type sharing one weight with the drawing

observation.zh: 片名占了大半个画面，却只有轮廓，底色从头到尾透着；描边的粗细与左下角狗屋线稿的线宽看起来是同一个数。字因此没有被读成一块黑，而是和线稿同属一层。
observation.en: The title takes most of the frame yet only its contour is drawn, so the ground shows through everywhere. Its stroke looks like the same number as the line width of the doghouse drawing. The type never reads as a black mass; it belongs to the same layer as the drawing.

zh: 先量出画面线稿的线宽，取它作为唯一的描边值。
把标题按实心排出，确认字号足够大，大到实心会压过画面。
改成只描边、不填色，描边粗细用第一步量出的那个值。
检查字号：字号不够大时空心会显得发虚，此时应加大字号而不是加粗描边。
确认字腔里的底色仍然看得见线稿或背景，没有被描边自己填住。
en: Measure the line width of the drawing first and take it as the only stroke value on the page.
Set the title solid and confirm the size is big enough that a fill would flatten the frame.
Switch it to outline only, at exactly the width you measured.
Check the size: a hollow face looks weak when it is too small, so grow the type rather than thickening the stroke.
Confirm the ground still shows through the counters instead of being closed off by the outline itself.

exercise.zh: 找一张带线稿的画面，把标题改成空心，描边量到与线稿同一个线宽，然后对比加粗一倍的版本，看哪个才开始不像同一张图上的东西。
exercise.en: Take any frame with a line drawing, switch the title to an outline at the drawing's own line width, then compare against a version at double that width and see which one stops looking like part of the same image.

zh: 描边宽度与画面线稿是否逐处一致，没有一处例外
字腔是否通到底色，没有被描边封死
字号是否大到空心仍然立得住
en: Does the stroke match the drawing everywhere, with no exception?
Do the counters open onto the ground instead of being sealed by the outline?
Is the size large enough that the hollow form still stands?

caution.zh: 空心字靠字号活命。字号一缩，描边就相对变粗，字腔糊掉，空心也就白做了。空心也不适合放在花纹复杂的底上，因为底色会跟着一起读进来。
caution.en: A hollow face lives on its size. Shrink it and the stroke grows relatively heavier, the counters clog, and the whole point is lost. It also fails over a busy ground, because the ground reads in through the counters.

prompt.zh: 请在一张带线稿插画的画面里排一个大标题：标题只画轮廓不填色，描边宽度严格等于插画的线宽，全图所有线的粗细只有这一个值。标题字号要大，大到字腔能透出背景。构图上一个对象压在另一个上，不要阴影、渐变和第三种线宽。
prompt.en: In a frame that already contains a line-drawing illustration, set one large title as contour only, its stroke exactly the drawing's line width, so the whole image uses a single line weight. Make the title large enough that its counters show the ground through. Let one object overlap another in the composition, with no shadow, no gradient and no third weight.

zh: 弧线基线：逐字转到切线角
en: Arc baseline: every glyph turns to the tangent
dz: 整行字沿一条圆弧走，每个字按所在位置的切线角自转。
de: The line rides an arc and each glyph rotates to the tangent at its own position.
pz: 先定圆弧，再把每个字绕自己的基线点转到该处的切线角；弯道外侧会拉开，必须补一点负字距，否则词在弧上散架。
pe: Fix the arc first, then rotate each glyph about its own baseline point to the tangent there. The outside of the curve opens up, so pull some of that gap back or the word falls apart along the arc.

caption.zh: 两行字沿圆弧抬升
caption.en: Two lines lifted along an arc

observation.zh: DOWN 和 OUTING 的下缘都不在直线上，而是各自贴着一条上拱的弧；每个字都转了自己的角度，越靠外侧的倾角越大。首尾两个字几乎落在同一条虚线上，中间拱起来一大截。
observation.en: Neither DOWN nor OUTING sits on a straight line: each rides its own upward arc, and every glyph carries its own angle, steeper toward the ends. The first and last letters land on what is almost one horizontal, while the middle lifts well clear of it.

zh: 先按普通方式把整行字排直，定好字号与字距。
在字下画一条圆弧当基线，弧高控制在字高的三分之一以内。
把每个字移到弧上自己的位置，并绕自己的基线点旋转到该处的切线角。
检查弯道外侧：相邻两字之间被拉开的地方补回一点字距，内侧不要挤死。
眯眼看整行：如果先看到一条弧再看到字，弧就画过头了。
en: Set the line straight first, at its final size and spacing.
Draw an arc under it as the baseline, with a rise under a third of the cap height.
Move each glyph to its own place on the curve and rotate it about its own baseline point to the tangent there.
Work the outside of the curve: pull back the gaps that opened, and never let the inside crush.
Squint at the line: if you see an arc before you see a word, the arc is too strong.

exercise.zh: 取一个五到七个字母的短词，排成上拱的弧线，弧高分别取字高的四分之一、二分之一和四分之三各做一版，看从哪一版开始读的不再是词而是弧。
exercise.en: Take a short word of five to seven letters and set it on an upward arc three times, with the rise at a quarter, a half and three quarters of the cap height, then see at which version you stop reading a word and start reading an arc.

zh: 每个字是否绕自己的基线点旋转，而不是整块一起斜
弧高是否小于字高的三分之一
弯道外侧被拉开的字距是否补了回来
首尾两字的下缘是否大致回到同一条水平线
en: Does each glyph rotate about its own baseline point rather than the block tilting as one?
Is the rise under a third of the cap height?
Have the gaps that opened on the outside been pulled back?
Do the two end letters come back to roughly one horizontal?

caution.zh: 弧高一大，字就从标题变成图案，可读性直接崩掉。另一个常见错误是整块一起旋转：那样字与弧的切线并不平行，弧看起来是歪的，字也滑出了基线。
caution.en: Past a certain rise the line stops being a title and becomes ornament, and readability goes with it. The other common mistake is rotating the whole block at once: then the glyphs are not parallel to the tangent, the arc looks crooked, and the letters slide off their baseline.

prompt.zh: 请把一个五到七个字母的短词排成一条上拱的弧线：弧高约等于字高的四分之一，字距均匀，每个字母绕自己的基线点旋转到所在位置的切线角，弯道外侧的字距稍作回收，首尾两字的下缘大致齐平。字用单一深色，背景留白，不要描边、阴影和装饰。
prompt.en: Set a short word of five to seven letters on an upward arc whose rise is about a quarter of the cap height, spacing even, rotating each letter about its own baseline point to the tangent at its position, pulling the outside spacing back slightly so the first and last letters end up roughly level. One dark colour for the type, plain background, no outline, no shadow, no ornament.

zh: 虚词缩小，夹在两段实词之间
en: Function words shrink and bridge the two content words
dz: 虚词降到实词的三分之一，换成斜体，卡在两个实词之间的缝里。
de: The small words drop to a third of the content words, switch to italic, and sit in the gap between them.
pz: the cat 与 mermouse 一样大，中间的 and the 缩到约三分之一、换成斜体，落位略偏上，把上下两个实词缝成一个标题。
pe: THE CAT and MERMOUSE carry the same size; the and the in between drops to about a third, switches to italic and sits slightly high, stitching the two content words into one title.

caption.zh: 两段实词中间夹一块小字
caption.en: A small block wedged between two large ones

observation.zh: 标题里只有两个实词，中间的功能词被压到实词的三分之一左右，还换了字体以示区别。它没有自己另起一行，而是坐在两个实词之间的缝里，两个实词因此读成一个整体。
observation.en: The title has only two content words; the function words between them are pushed down to roughly a third of that size and switched into another style. They do not take a line of their own but sit in the gap between the two, so the two read as one title.

zh: 先把标题里的实词挑出来，虚词单独标一份。
两个实词用同一档字号排直，间距按正常词距。
虚词缩到实词的三分之一左右，换成斜体或另一种笔画气质。
把虚词放进两个实词之间，下缘略高于实词基线，让它落在缝里而不是另起一行。
en: Pick the content words out of the title and mark the function words separately.
Set the two content words at one size on one line, at normal word spacing.
Shrink the function words to about a third and switch them to italic or another stroke temperament.
Drop them into the gap between the two content words, sitting slightly above their baseline rather than taking a line of their own.

exercise.zh: 拿一个 X and the Y 形式的标题做三版：虚词与实词同大、缩到一半、缩到三分之一，看哪一版两个实词才真正合成一个整体。
exercise.en: Take a title of the form X and the Y and set three versions: function words at full size, at half and at a third. See at which one the two content words finally read as a single title.

zh: 虚词与实词之间是否有明显的一档字号差，而不是同一档
虚词是否落在两个实词之间，没有另起一行
缩到阅读尺寸后，虚词是否还认得出是什么词
en: Is there one clear size step between the function words and the content words?
Do the function words sit between the two, instead of on their own line?
At reading size, can you still tell which word they are?

caution.zh: 虚词不能缩到认不出，也不能和实词同一档字号，否则两个实词之间的层级塌掉，标题又变回一行平铺的字。换字体是为了区分功能，不是为了让虚词更好看。
caution.en: The function words must not shrink past recognition, and must not share the content words' size step, or the hierarchy collapses and the title flattens back into one even line. The style change marks function, not prettiness.

prompt.zh: 请排一个 X and the Y 形式的标题：两个实词用同一档大字号、同一条基线；中间的 and the 缩到实词的三分之一，换成斜体，下缘略高于实词基线，夹在两个实词之间的缝里，不另起一行。两个字词块的下缘严格对齐，全图只有一档字号台阶，不要第三种字号。
prompt.en: Set a title of the form X and the Y. Put both content words at one large size on one shared baseline. Shrink the and the in between to a third of that, switch it to italic, lift its lower edge slightly above the content baseline and tuck it into the gap without giving it a line of its own. The two content blocks must bottom out on exactly one line, and the page carries one size step only, no third size.

zh: 标题按背景网格的模数分块落位
en: Title placed on the background grid's own modules
dz: 背景是菱形模数网格，标题不另起一层，直接占用其中的格子。
de: The background is a diamond module grid, and the title occupies its cells instead of sitting on a layer above.
pz: 实词各占一个大菱形格，虚词占中间嵌进凹口的半格，字不另起一层，看起来是从网格里长出来的。
pe: Each content word takes one large diamond and the function word takes the half-size diamond nested where the two meet. Nothing sits on a layer above; the title reads as if it grew out of the grid.

caption.zh: 标点占格，字在格内
caption.en: Words in cells, not on top of the pattern

observation.zh: 背景是一整片菱形模数，标题没有浮在上面：两个实词各自落进一个大菱形，虚词落进两个大菱形交角处的那个半格小菱形。字与背景共用一套模数，标题因此像是从图案里长出来的。
observation.en: The background is one field of diamond modules, and the title never floats above it: each content word lands in its own large diamond, and the function word lands in the half-size diamond that nests in the notch where the two meet. Type and background share one module, so the title reads as if it grew out of the pattern.

zh: 先定模数：画出菱形的对角线长度，让整片网格由这一个数生成。
把标题拆成字数最少的分块，尽量让每块落进一个完整格子。
实词各占一个整格，虚词占两格交角处的半格。
检查每块字是否真的在格内居中，四角到格边留出的距离要一致。
把网格线的线宽压到刚好可辨，让格子退到字的后面。
en: Fix the module first: draw the diamond's diagonal so the whole field is generated from that one number.
Break the title into as few blocks as possible, aiming for one complete cell each.
Give each content word a full cell and the function word the half-size cell where two cells meet.
Check that every block is really centred in its cell, with equal clearance to all four edges.
Thin the grid lines until they are just visible, so the cells step behind the words.

exercise.zh: 先画一片菱形网格，再把一个四到五个词的标题塞进去，只准占用已有的格子，一个词也不许跨格；塞不下就改标题的分行，不许改网格。
exercise.en: Draw a field of diamond modules, then fit a four to five word title into it using existing cells only, with no word allowed to straddle an edge. If it does not fit, change the line breaks, never the grid.

zh: 每个字块是否落在格内居中，没有骑在格线上
虚词占的格子是否明显小于实词的格子
网格线是否细到不抢字，字的明度是否明显高于格线
en: Is every block centred inside its cell instead of sitting on an edge?
Is the function word's cell clearly smaller than the content words'?
Are the grid lines light enough not to compete, with the words clearly stronger in value?

caution.zh: 字一旦不按格落位，标题就变回贴在图案上的一层，网格也白画了。另一种常见失败是格线太重，模数抢到前面，读者的眼睛先去数格子而不是读词。
caution.en: Let the words fall off the cells and the title drops back to being a layer pasted over a pattern, which wastes the grid entirely. The other common failure is grid lines that are too heavy: the module steps forward and the eye counts cells instead of reading the words.

prompt.zh: 请先画一片菱形模数网格，对角线长度取一个固定值，全图只由这一个数生成，格线要细到刚好看见。再把一个四到五个词的标题拆成几块塞进格子里：实词各占一个完整大菱形并居中，虚词占两个大菱形交角处的那个半格小菱形，任何字块都不许骑格线或跨格。字用同一档字号与字重，靠格子而不是靠字号区分主次。
prompt.en: Draw a field of diamond modules generated from one fixed diagonal length, with grid lines thin enough to be only just visible. Fit a four to five word title into the cells: each content word centred in one full diamond, the function word in the half-size diamond nested where two large ones meet, and no block ever straddling an edge. Set every block at one size and one weight, letting the cells rather than the type sizes carry the hierarchy.

zh: 小字嵌进大字的字怀
en: Nest the sub-word in the big glyph's counter
dz: 主字占满画面，从属的小字缩到很小，住进它笔画围出的空当。
de: The main glyph fills the frame; the sub-word shrinks and moves into the void its strokes enclose.
pz: 一个超大数字先一个人占住整块版心，它笔画围出的那块负形正好塞得下一行小字。从属词不往版外跑，也不压在主字的笔画上。
pe: One oversized figure takes the whole field on its own, and the void its strokes enclose is exactly the size of a small line of type. The sub-word neither spills outside nor sits on top of a stroke.

caption.zh: 从属词住进主字让出的空当
caption.en: The sub-word lives in the void the main glyph leaves

observation.zh: 这张版只有一个超大数字，其余的字都被缩到很小。小字的位置不在版边，而在数字笔画围出的那块空里，四面都留着均匀的缝。
observation.en: The field holds one oversized figure and nothing else at that size. The small word does not sit beside it, it sits inside the void the strokes enclose, with an even gap on every side.

zh: 先只放主字，让它一个人占满版心，再决定它摆在哪儿。
看主字笔画围出了哪几块空当，挑出最大的一块。
把从属词缩到主字的五分之一到十分之一，横向居中放进这块空当。
四面留出同样宽的缝，小字不碰到任何一笔。
en: Set the main glyph alone first, at a size where it can hold the whole field, then decide where it sits.
Look at the voids the strokes enclose and pick the largest one.
Shrink the sub-word to a fifth or a tenth of that size and centre it inside the void.
Keep an equal gap on all four sides so no stroke touches the small word.

exercise.zh: 挑一个要当主角的字符或数字放到占满版心，再从从属信息里选最短的一条，塞进它笔画围出的那块空当。
exercise.en: Take one character or figure as the lead, set it large enough to hold the field, then pick the shortest piece of supporting information and drop it into the void the strokes enclose.

zh: 四面的缝是否一样宽
缩到最小以后是否还读得出来
主字单独看时是否仍是画面里最大的东西
en: Is the gap the same width on all four sides?
Does the sub-word stay readable at its smallest size?
Is the main glyph still the largest thing on the page when you look at it alone?

caution.zh: 字怀太小就别硬塞，宁可换一个笔画更空的主字，也不要把小字压到笔画上。
caution.en: If the counter is too small, do not force it. Swap in a main glyph with more open strokes rather than letting the small word touch a stroke.

prompt.zh: 请排一张只有一个数字和一行小字的版式：数字放大到占满版心，笔画粗、拐角方；小字只有三四个字符，缩到数字的五分之一，放进数字笔画围出的那块空当里，四面留出一样宽的缝，不要压到任何一笔。浅灰底，数字用深橄榄绿，小字用朱橙。
prompt.en: Build a layout with one figure and one short line. Set the figure large enough to hold the whole field, with heavy strokes and square corners. The small line is only three or four characters, at a fifth of that size, placed inside the void the figure's strokes enclose, with an equal gap on all four sides and no overlap with any stroke. Off-white ground, deep olive for the figure, coral for the small line.

zh: 同一个词跨色块反相重排
en: Repeat one word inverted across the split
dz: 一条水平线把画面切成两块，同一个词在上下各出现一次，颜色反过来。
de: A horizon splits the field in two; the same word appears in each half with its colour flipped.
pz: 画面被一条水平线切成上下两块，浅底在上、深底在下。同一个词出现两次：上边是黑字落在浅底上，下边是白字落在深底上，第二份向右错开半个词的宽度。
pe: A horizon cuts the field into a light upper half and a dark lower half. The same word appears twice: black on the light half, white on the dark half, with the second copy shifted right by about half its own width.

caption.zh: 同一个词在分界上下各出现一次
caption.en: The same word lands once in each half

observation.zh: 上半是浅底黑字，下半是深底白字，两处写的是同一个词。第二份起步的位置比第一份往右挪了半个词，两个起点之间那段空就是错位的量。
observation.en: Black type on a light upper half, white type on a dark lower half, and both read the same word. The second copy starts about half a word to the right of the first; the gap between the two starting points is the offset.

zh: 先把画面水平切开，上浅下深，切线的位置定死。
把同一个词按同一字号、同一字距排两遍。
上份贴着切线上方落基线，颜色取深色。
下份落进下半区，颜色取浅色，起点向右挪半个词宽。
en: Cut the field horizontally first, light above and dark below, and fix the cut where it is.
Set the same word twice at one size and one tracking.
Land the upper copy's baseline just above the cut, in the dark colour.
Drop the lower copy into the dark half in the light colour and start it half a word to the right.

exercise.zh: 挑一个四到六个字母的词，做成深浅两半的版面，把同一个词在上下各排一次并反相，第二份错开半个词宽。
exercise.en: Take a four to six letter word, build a field in two halves of light and dark, and set the word once in each half with its colour flipped and the second copy offset by half a word.

zh: 两份字是否完全同字号同字距
配色是否与所在半区的明度相反
第二份的起点是否稳定错开约半个词宽
en: Do both copies share one size and one tracking?
Does each copy's colour run opposite to the value of its half?
Is the second copy offset by a steady half word?

caution.zh: 错位量太小会读成重影，太大就变成两个词。半个词宽上下，才读得出这是同一个词。
caution.en: Too small an offset reads as a smudge, too large and it becomes two different words. Around half a word is where the repeat still reads as one.

prompt.zh: 请做一张上下分区的版面：上半浅底、下半深底，分界线水平贯穿。取同一个英文单词，在上下两区各排一次，字号字距完全一致，上份黑色、下份白色，下份的起点比上份往右挪半个词宽，让两个起点之间的错位量一眼看得出来。不要加任何别的装饰。
prompt.en: Design a field split horizontally into a light upper half and a dark lower half, the dividing line running edge to edge. Take one English word and set it once in each half at exactly the same size and tracking: black above, white below, with the lower copy started half a word to the right so the offset between the two starting points is obvious at a glance. Add no other ornament.

zh: 硬断单词，用行数换宽度
en: Break the word up; trade width for lines
dz: 一个词被拆到三行，各行左齐，宽度是用高度换回来的。
de: One word split over three lines, each flush left, buys its width back with height.
pz: 长词在一行里占得太宽，就把它硬断成三行，每行从左边同一处起排。整块的字宽缩到原来的三分之一，腾出来的宽度用三行高度换。
pe: When a long word runs too wide on one line, break it across three lines, each starting at the same left edge. The block's width drops to roughly a third of the single line, paid for in height.

caption.zh: 断成三行，把宽度换回来
caption.en: Three lines buy the width back

observation.zh: 画面里是一个单词，被拆成三段排在三行上，右边参差、左边齐平。末行排完还剩一段空位，刚好放得下序号。
observation.en: One word sits broken into three rows, ragged on the right and flush on the left. The last row leaves a gap that is exactly the room a serial number needs.

zh: 先按一行排一遍，量出它到底占多宽。
用可用栏宽去除以这个宽度，得出至少要断成几行。
按固定的每行字符数硬断，不要迁就音节。
三行从同一条左边界起排，右边自然参差，末行空位留给序号。
en: Set the word on one line first and measure how wide it actually runs.
Divide the available column width by that figure to get the minimum number of lines.
Break at a fixed character count per line; do not break by syllable.
Start every line at one left edge, let the right side run ragged, and give the last row's leftover space to the serial number.

exercise.zh: 找一个六字母以上的词，先排成一行量宽度，再按每行固定字符数硬断成三行，看整块能不能收进目标栏宽。
exercise.en: Take a word of six letters or more, set it on one line and measure it, then break it into three lines at a fixed count per line and see whether the block now fits the target column.

zh: 每行是否从同一条左边界起排
断点是否按固定字符数而不是词义
整块的高度是否还在可用范围内
en: Does every line start at the same left edge?
Do the breaks fall on a fixed character count rather than on meaning?
Is the block's height still inside the space you have?

caution.zh: 断词只对短词和展示用的大字有效。正文里断词会打断阅读，别把这招带进去。
caution.en: Breaking a word only works for short words set as display type. In running text it interrupts reading, so keep it out of body copy.

prompt.zh: 请排一个展示用的英文单词，把它硬断成三行，各行从同一条左边界起排、右边参差；末行末尾留出的空位放一个两位数字，字母用深墨绿，数字用朱橙。整块收紧成一块竖长的矩形，四周不加任何装饰，让我一眼看出宽度是靠行数换来的。
prompt.en: Set one English word as display type and break it hard across three lines, every line starting at the same left edge with a ragged right. Put a two-digit number in the gap left at the end of the last row. Deep olive for the letters, coral for the number. Compress the whole thing into one tall rectangle with no ornament around it, so the width plainly reads as bought with line count.

zh: 笔画与格线同粗并接上
en: Match the stroke weight to the ruling
dz: 字的笔画和背景格线一样粗，末端直接接在线上，读成一体。
de: Strokes take the weight of the ruling and meet it end to end, so the type reads as part of the grid.
pz: 背景是一组粗细一致的格线，字也用同样的线宽画出来，末端正好落在格线上，不重叠也不留缝。看过去分不清哪一段是线、哪一段是字。
pe: The ground is a set of rules all drawn at one weight. The type is drawn at that same weight, its ends landing exactly on the rules with no overlap and no gap. Nothing tells you where a rule stops and a letter starts.

caption.zh: 字和线用同一个线宽
caption.en: Type and ruling share one weight

observation.zh: 画面里的横线和竖线粗细完全一样，字的笔画也是这个粗细。笔画的两头接在格线上，接头处既没有断开，也没有加厚。
observation.en: Every horizontal and vertical rule is drawn at one weight, and the letter strokes are drawn at that same weight. Where a stroke meets a rule there is neither a break nor a thickening.

zh: 先定一个线宽，整张画面的格线全用这个宽度画出来。
字的笔画也取这个宽度，末端用和格线相同的圆头或方头。
把笔画端点对到格线上，端点落在线的中心，不重叠也不留缝。
退到一臂远看：如果还能一眼分出线和字，说明粗细或接头没对上。
en: Fix one weight first and draw every rule on the page at that weight.
Draw the letter strokes at that same weight, with the same round or square terminals as the rules.
Land each stroke end on the centre of a rule, with no overlap and no gap.
Step back an arm's length: if you can still separate rule from letter at a glance, the weight or the joint is off.

exercise.zh: 用同一线宽画一组横竖格线，再把一个字母的笔画也按这个宽度画进去，让它的笔画端点落在格线上，检查接头是否干净。
exercise.en: Draw a set of horizontal and vertical rules at one weight, then draw one letter's strokes at that same weight with its ends landing on the rules, and check that every joint is clean.

zh: 格线与笔画是否同宽
接头处是否既不重叠也不断开
笔画末端与格线端点是否同一种形状
en: Are the rules and the strokes the same width?
At each joint, is there neither overlap nor a gap?
Do the stroke ends and the rule ends share one terminal shape?

caution.zh: 这招只在纯线构的画面里成立。一旦有实心色块或图片，同宽的笔画就会糊进去。
caution.en: This only holds on a page built from pure line. Add a solid block or an image and the matched strokes dissolve into it.

prompt.zh: 请用同一种线宽画一张线构版面：横竖格线全部同粗、末端圆头，粗细在整张画面里不变化。再把一个字母的笔画按同一线宽画进去，笔画端点正好落在格线的中心上，接头处不重叠、不留缝。字母用朱橙，其余所有线用深橄榄绿，让这处笔画在一堆同宽的线里被认出来。
prompt.en: Build a page out of line alone, with one stroke weight: all horizontal and vertical rules the same width, round terminals, no variation anywhere on the page. Then draw one letter's strokes at that same width, its ends landing exactly on the centreline of the rules, with no overlap and no gap at the joints. Make the letter coral and every other line deep olive, so that one set of strokes is picked out from a field of identical-width lines.

zh: 把报幕做成可平铺的单元
en: Tile one unit to fill the frame
dz: 一个圆角色块装下词标、编号和剪影，错行铺满整张。
de: One rounded block holds wordmark, number and silhouette; offset rows tile the whole frame.
pz: 先把同一个单元做完整：词标、编号、剪影三件挤在一块圆角色块里。上下行错开半格铺开，靠单元之间的空隙维持节奏，四边一律出血不封口。
pe: Build one tile first: wordmark, issue number and a small silhouette packed into a single rounded block. Lay them in rows, offset each row by half a tile, let the gaps carry the rhythm, and bleed every edge.

caption.zh: 一个单元，铺满整幅
caption.en: One unit, tiled edge to edge

observation.zh: 整张画面没有第二套版式，只有同一个单元被重复了三十几次。每个圆角色块里都是同样的三件事，位置固定；相邻两行错开半个单元宽，所以竖缝从来不会连成一条贯通的长缝。
observation.en: The frame holds no second layout, only one unit repeated thirty-odd times. Every rounded block carries the same three items in the same fixed positions, and rows are offset by half a tile, so the vertical gaps never line up into a continuous seam.

zh: 先只画一个单元：定好它的宽高，把词标、编号、剪影按固定位置摆进去，四周留出等宽的内边距。
把这个单元横向、纵向等距重复，铺满并溢出画幅四边，不要收口。
把每一行（或每一列）整体平移半个单元宽，让上下相邻的单元错开。
检查单元之间的空隙是否各向等宽；某一条缝明显更宽就说明行距和列距没配好。
en: Draw one tile only: fix its width and height, place the wordmark, number and silhouette at fixed positions inside, and keep the padding equal on all four sides.
Repeat that tile at an even pitch horizontally and vertically until it overflows every edge. Do not close the pattern off.
Shift every other row (or column) by half a tile so neighbouring tiles stagger.
Check that the gaps are equal in both directions. A seam that reads wider means the row and column pitches do not match.

exercise.zh: 拿一条只有三个元素的短信息（标题、编号、一个小图形），把它做成一个单元，然后铺满 A3 一整面，四边出血。做完退到两米外看：应该先看到一层均匀的纹理，走近才读出单元里的字。
exercise.en: Take a short message with three elements only, a title, a number and one small mark, turn it into a tile, and tile a whole A3 sheet with it, bleeding all four edges. Step two metres back: you should see an even texture first and read the tile's content only up close.

zh: 单元内部有没有固定的对齐关系，还是每次摆放都不一样
错位的方向是否始终一致，没有一行反着错
单元之间的空隙在两个方向上是否等宽
退到两米外，画面是否读起来是一层纹理而不是一堆零散的字
en: Does the tile keep a fixed internal alignment, or is it re-composed every time?
Is the offset always in the same direction, with no row shifted the other way?
Are the gaps equal in both directions?
At two metres, does it read as one texture rather than loose scattered words?

caution.zh: 单元里塞的东西一多，平铺后就是一团噪声，字数超过五六个就不该用平铺。另外单元别做得太大，一屏只放得下四五个就没有重复感了。
caution.en: Pack too much into the tile and the repetition turns into noise. Past five or six items, tiling is the wrong device. Keep the tile small as well: if only four or five fit on a screen, the repetition never registers.

prompt.zh: 请设计一个可平铺的单元并用它铺满 16:10 的画幅。单元是一个圆角矩形色块，内部固定放三件东西：一行拉丁词标、一个两位数字编号、一个小的实心剪影，三件都靠左、上下有固定间距，四周内边距等宽。把单元按等距行列重复，上下相邻行错开半个单元宽，图案溢出画幅四边不留边距。颜色只用一种主色加深底，单元内的字反白。不要加投影、渐变或任何装饰。
prompt.en: Design one tile and use it to fill a 16:10 canvas. The tile is a rounded rectangle containing three fixed items: a Latin wordmark, a two-digit number, and a small solid silhouette. All three align left with fixed vertical spacing and equal padding on all sides. Repeat the tile on an even row-and-column pitch, offset every other row by half a tile, and let the pattern overflow all four edges with no margin. Use one main colour on a dark ground with reversed type inside the tile. No shadows, gradients or ornament.

zh: 旋转内缩的方框把视线收进去
en: Rotating frames spiral the eye inward
dz: 每层方框转一点、缩一圈，编号留在最内层的空白里。
de: Each frame rotates a few degrees and shrinks; the number waits in the innermost blank.
pz: 同一组方框一层层往内叠，每叠一层就旋转几度、缩小固定比例，四个角因此错开成一条旋转的隧道；最内一层不再画框，只留一块干净的矩形给编号。
pe: Repeat one frame inward, rotating a few degrees and shrinking by a fixed ratio each step, so the four corners stagger into a spinning tunnel. The innermost step is no frame, just a clean rectangle for the number.

caption.zh: 框一层层转着缩小
caption.en: Frames rotating and shrinking inward

observation.zh: 画面里全是矩形轮廓，没有一张图。外框最大，往内每层都缩小一档并转过一个固定角度，所以四个角从来不会重合，边框之间始终留着一圈不等宽的空隙，看着像往深处钻。最里面那层没有边框，只有一块静下来的白。
observation.en: The frame holds nothing but rectangle outlines. The outermost is the largest; each step inward shrinks by a fixed ratio and turns by a fixed angle, so the corners never coincide and the gap between rings keeps changing width, which reads as depth. The innermost step has no outline at all, only a quiet blank.

zh: 先画一个最大的矩形轮廓，居中放在画幅里，四边留出大致相等的余量。
复制这个矩形，每复制一层就按同一个比例缩小，同时绕中心旋转同一个固定角度，一般三到六度就够。
重复六到十层；层数太少看不出隧道，太多后面几层会挤在中心糊成一团。
把最内两三层的线去掉，留出一块干净的矩形放编号，字号不超过这块矩形的三分之二高。
en: Draw one largest rectangle outline, centred in the canvas with roughly equal margins.
Duplicate it, and for each copy apply the same scale factor and the same rotation about the centre. Three to six degrees per step is usually enough.
Repeat for six to ten steps. Fewer and there is no tunnel; many more and the last steps pile up into a blob at the centre.
Delete the outlines of the last two or three steps, leaving a clean rectangle for the number, set no taller than two-thirds of that rectangle.

exercise.zh: 做一个「往里钻」的版式：只允许用矩形轮廓，不许用任何图像和渐变，把观众的视线送到正中心的一个数字上。定好比例和角度之后就不要中途改，全部层共用一个中心和一个比例。
exercise.en: Build an inward-spiralling layout using rectangle outlines only, no images and no gradients, that delivers the eye to a single number at dead centre. Once you fix the ratio and the angle, do not change them midway: every step shares one centre and one scale factor.

zh: 所有层是否共用同一个中心和同一个缩放比例
相邻两层之间的空隙有没有形成明显的宽窄节奏
最内层是否真的安静，没有被框线或装饰干扰
中心那块留白能不能容下编号，且编号不贴边
en: Do all steps share one centre and one scale factor?
Do the gaps between rings create a visible rhythm of widths?
Is the innermost step genuinely quiet, free of outlines or ornament?
Does the central blank hold the number without crowding its edges?

caution.zh: 旋转角度一大就变成万花筒，读者看不出是同一组方框，只会觉得乱。要的是「同一张框转着缩小」，不是「随便转的方框堆」。
caution.en: Push the angle too far and it becomes a kaleidoscope: readers stop seeing one frame repeated and just see clutter. The point is one frame turning as it shrinks, not a heap of arbitrary rectangles.

prompt.zh: 请做一个居中、向内旋转收缩的矩形隧道版式。最外一个矩形占画幅的八成宽，往里共八层，每层缩放 0.84、绕中心旋转 4 度，只描边不填充，线宽一致。最内两层不画线，留出一块干净矩形放一个两位数字，数字居中、颜色最深。整体底色浅灰，线条用中灰，数字用深色。不要渐变、不要阴影、不要其他图形。
prompt.en: Build a centred, inward-rotating rectangular tunnel. The outer rectangle takes eighty percent of the canvas width; go eight steps inward, each scaled to 0.84 and rotated four degrees about the centre, stroke only, no fill, one uniform stroke weight. Leave the innermost two steps without outlines so a clean rectangle holds a two-digit number, centred and in the darkest value. Pale grey ground, mid-grey strokes, dark number. No gradients, no shadows, no other shapes.

zh: 让主体跨在色块分界线上
en: Let the subject straddle the split line
dz: 分界线穿过主体，上下两块因此连成一个画面。
de: The split line runs through the subject, so the two fields read as one image.
pz: 一条水平线把画幅分成深浅两块。不要躲开它——把最大的字正压在线上，让字的上半用浅色、下半用深色，两块地就咬在了一起。
pe: One horizontal line cuts the frame into two fields of different value. Do not dodge it: set the largest word straight across the line and give its upper and lower halves the two contrasting colors.

caption.zh: 一个字横跨两块底
caption.en: One word across two grounds

observation.zh: 画幅被一条水平线切成两半，上半深、下半浅。最大的数字没有被安排到任何一半里，而是正压在分界线上，上半在深底上反白、下半在浅底上转黑。这条线因此不再是画面的边界，而成了主体的轴线。
observation.en: A single horizontal line cuts the frame in half, dark above, light below. The largest numeral is not placed in either half; it sits straight across the line, reversed out white on the dark field and turned black on the light one. The line stops being a boundary and becomes the subject's own axis.

zh: 先用一条水平线把画幅分成两块，两块用明显不同的明度，不要用两个相近的灰。
把最大的字或数字居中放在这条线上，让它的字面高度被线大致平分，上半和下半各占一半左右。
给字做两套颜色：落在深底上的部分用浅色，落在浅底上的部分用深色，交界处不做过渡。
剩下的小字（词标、编号）压到线的某一侧，紧贴分界线排，但不要再去骑它。
en: Split the frame with one horizontal line into two fields of clearly different value. Two similar greys will not do.
Centre the largest word or numeral on that line so its cap height is roughly bisected, half above and half below.
Give the glyph two colours: the part on the dark field in a light tone, the part on the light field in a dark tone, with no transition at the meeting point.
Set the remaining small text, the wordmark or number, tight against one side of the line. Do not let it straddle the line as well.

exercise.zh: 只用一个词和一个数字，做一张上下分色的版面：数字骑线，词标压在下半区贴着线排。不允许用照片、渐变、投影，只有两块平涂色和一个跨线的字。
exercise.en: With one word and one number, build a two-field layout: the number straddles the line, the wordmark sits in the lower field hugging the line. No photographs, gradients or shadows, just two flat fields and one glyph across the divide.

zh: 分界线是否真的穿过字面，而不是擦着字的上缘或下缘
上下两块的明度差是否够大，反色之后两边都读得清
交界处有没有出现第三种颜色或半透明的过渡
小字是否安分地待在某一侧，没有跟着一起骑线
en: Does the line truly pass through the glyph, rather than grazing its top or bottom edge?
Is the value gap between the fields wide enough for both halves to stay legible?
Has a third colour or a translucent blend appeared at the meeting point?
Does the small text stay on one side instead of straddling the line too?

caution.zh: 跨线的字必须足够大。字太小的时候，分界线会把字切成两段难认的碎块，跨骑就只剩破坏。上下的明度差也要够，深浅只差一点的时候反色根本看不出来。
caution.en: The straddling glyph must be large. On a small glyph the line just cuts it into two illegible fragments and the device only damages. The value gap matters too: if the two fields differ only slightly, the inverted halves will not register at all.

prompt.zh: 请排一张 16:10 的版面。画幅用一条水平线均分成上下两块：上半深墨色，下半浅米色。一个超大的两位数字居中压在这条线上，字面高度被线平分；数字落在深色部分的地方用米白填充，落在浅色部分的地方用深墨色填充，交界处干净利落不要渐变。左下角放一行很小的拉丁词标，压在下半区、紧贴分界线下方对齐数字的左边缘。不要图片、不要阴影、不要多余装饰。
prompt.en: Lay out a 16:10 page. Split it with one horizontal line into two equal fields: deep ink above, pale cream below. Place one very large two-digit number centred on the line so its cap height is bisected. Fill the part over the dark field in cream and the part over the light field in deep ink, with a clean edge and no gradient. Bottom left, set one small Latin wordmark in the lower field, tight under the line, left-aligned to the number. No images, no shadows, no extra ornament.

zh: 数字照词标的骨架重画一遍
en: Redraw the numeral in the wordmark's skeleton
dz: 数字不能直接打字，要按词标的笔画语言重画。
de: Do not just type the number: rebuild it in the stroke language of the wordmark.
pz: 词标的笔画端部收成尖角、转折带菱线，数字就得照这套重画：端头同样收尖，粗细节奏一致，两者才像同一个家族。
pe: If the wordmark ends its strokes in points and flashes diamonds at the joints, the number must be rebuilt the same way, with matching points and the same thick-thin rhythm. Only then do the two read as one family.

caption.zh: 骨架不变，换一副笔画
caption.en: Same skeleton, new strokes

observation.zh: 画面里的数字不是现成字体打出来的。它的两根笔画都从中段最粗往两端收细，收成一个尖，转折的地方还多出一小块菱形的尖刺——这些正是旁边词标的笔画特征。数字和词标因此共享同一副骨架，看上去是一家人。
observation.en: The numeral here was not typed in an off-the-shelf face. Each stroke swells in the middle and tapers to a point at both ends, and the joint carries a small diamond spur, exactly the stroke features of the wordmark beside it. Because numeral and wordmark share one skeleton, they read as one family.

zh: 先把词标放大，量出它的三个笔画参数：端部怎么收（收尖还是收平）、中段最粗占字高的百分之几、转折处有没有附加的尖刺。
写下数字的中点骨架线，两根笔画各画成一条单线，此时完全不管粗细。
沿着骨架线把笔画重新描出来：中段加宽到词标的同一比例，两端收成同样的尖角。
在转折处补上词标同款的尖刺，最后把数字和词标并排缩小看，两者应该像同一个字模出来的。
en: Blow up the wordmark and measure three stroke parameters: how the ends finish (tapered or flat), what percentage of the cap height the thickest point takes, and whether the joints carry an added spur.
Draw the numeral's centre-line skeleton, one single line per stroke, ignoring weight entirely at this stage.
Trace the strokes back along that skeleton: widen the middle to the wordmark's ratio and taper both ends to the same point.
Add the matching spur at the joint, then shrink the numeral and wordmark side by side. They should look like they came off one punch.

exercise.zh: 挑一副有明确笔画性格的标题字（尖角、圆角或断裂），用它写一行词标，然后手绘一个阿拉伯数字，要求数字和词标共用同一副骨架。把两者缩到 12px 高并排看，如果数字先跳出来，说明它还没重画完。
exercise.en: Pick a display face with a decided stroke character, whether pointed, rounded or broken, set one wordmark line in it, then draw an Arabic numeral by hand on the same skeleton. Shrink both to twelve pixels tall and put them side by side; if the numeral jumps out first, it has not been rebuilt yet.

zh: 数字和词标的最粗处是否占同样的字高比例
两端的收法是否一致，没有一边收尖一边收平
转折处的附加尖刺有没有漏掉
缩到 12px 高并排看，数字会不会抢出来
en: Do numeral and wordmark take the same proportion of the cap height at their thickest?
Do both finish their ends the same way, rather than one tapering and one cutting flat?
Has the added spur at the joint been forgotten?
At twelve pixels tall, side by side, does the numeral jump out?

caution.zh: 不要直接给数字加描边或倾斜来「凑」。加粗描边会把端部的尖角糊成圆头，反而更不像。骨架对不上就重画骨架，不是在现成的字上贴东西。
caution.en: Do not fake it with an outline or a slant. A heavy stroke rounds off the pointed terminals and makes the mismatch worse. If the skeletons disagree, redraw the skeleton; do not paste effects onto an off-the-shelf glyph.

prompt.zh: 请画一个阿拉伯数字 7，笔画特征如下：两根笔画都从中段最粗往两端收成一个尖，最粗处约为字高的六分之一；转折处伸出一小块菱形尖刺；笔画末端不收圆角。画完之后，把它和一行使用完全相同笔画语言的拉丁词标并排放，两者的粗细节奏和端部处理必须一致。只用深色单色填充，不加描边、投影、渐变。
prompt.en: Draw the Arabic numeral 7 with these stroke features: each stroke swells from its thickest point in the middle and tapers to a point at both ends, the thickest being about one sixth of the cap height; a small diamond spur pushes out at the joint; no rounded ends. Then place it beside a line of Latin wordmark built from exactly the same stroke language, matching thick-thin rhythm and identical end treatment. One dark flat colour, no outline, shadow or gradient.

zh: 在规则阵列里改形，字就浮出来
en: Deform a few cells and the letters surface
dz: 规则排列的单元里，只改落在字形轮廓上的那几个。
de: In a regular array, change only the cells the letter outline crosses.
pz: 先把同样的圆顶单元等距铺满，再画出字形轮廓；轮廓压到的单元只改轮廓那一侧，其余一律不动。字因此半隐半现，退远才看得全。
pe: Tile identical domes at an even pitch, then lay the letter outline over them. Reshape only the cells the outline crosses and leave every other cell untouched, so the word stays half-hidden until you step back.

caption.zh: 字从阵列里长出来
caption.en: Letters growing out of the array

observation.zh: 画面先是一大片等距排列的圆顶，密到看不出单个数。字形不是画上去的，而是把落在轮廓上的那些单元翻转过来，于是字以「方向」而不是「颜色」的形式浮现，远看是一圈异样的斑点，凑近才读出字母。
observation.en: The frame is first of all a dense array of domes at an even pitch. The letters are not drawn on top: the cells that fall on the outline are simply turned over, so the word surfaces as a change of direction rather than a change of colour. From far it is an odd ring of specks; up close it resolves into letters.

zh: 先铺满阵列：所有单元同一个形状、同一个间距，不要一开始就留位置给字。
在阵列上画出字形轮廓，把它当作一把「选择器」，不要当作要填色的区域。
只把轮廓穿过或压到的那些单元改掉——翻转、镜像或换一个变体，幅度要刚好看得出「不一样」。
其余单元一个都不要动。然后把画幅缩到拇指大小看一眼：字若还是清清楚楚，说明改动的单元太多或者太大。
en: Tile the array first: every cell the same shape at the same pitch. Do not reserve space for the word in advance.
Draw the letter outline on top and treat it purely as a selector, not as a region to fill.
Change only the cells the outline crosses or clips, flipping, mirroring or swapping in a variant, with just enough distortion to read as different.
Leave every other cell untouched. Then shrink the whole thing to thumbnail size: if the word is still obvious, you changed too many cells or distorted them too far.

exercise.zh: 用同一种小图形（圆点、方块或半圆）等距铺满一张画，再让一个词的轮廓去「压」这些单元，只改被压到的部分。做完把图缩小十倍：字应该还在，但不再是一个被涂色的形状。
exercise.en: Tile one small shape, dot, square or half-disc, evenly across a sheet, then let the outline of a word press onto those cells and alter only what it touches. Shrink the result to a tenth: the word should survive, but no longer look like a filled-in shape.

zh: 阵列在没有字的地方是否完全规则，没有被提前挤压
被改动的单元数量是否远少于总数
改动的方向是否统一，不至于看起来像随机噪声
缩小到拇指大小之后，字还能不能读出来
en: Is the array perfectly regular everywhere the word is not, with no pre-emptive squeezing?
Are the altered cells far fewer than the untouched ones?
Is the direction of change consistent, rather than reading as random noise?
Does the word still read once shrunk to thumbnail size?

caution.zh: 这个手法靠的是「大部分不动」。一旦改动了太多单元、或者把单元换成完全不同的形状，就不再是阵列显字，只是把字画在噪点上。字太小也不行：轮廓压不到几个单元，字根本形不成。
caution.en: The whole device rests on most cells staying put. Once too many are altered, or a wholly different shape is swapped in, it stops being a word surfacing from an array and becomes a word drawn on noise. Too small a word fails as well: the outline will not cross enough cells to form.

prompt.zh: 请铺一张 16:10 的阵列：同一个半圆顶形状，横竖等距排列铺满整幅，间距固定，四边出血，全部用一种中间灰。然后让一个直径约画幅高度七成的圆形轮廓去压这些单元，只把轮廓经过的单元绕自身中心旋转 180 度并改成偏绿的一档颜色，其余单元保持原样不动。不要描出轮廓线，不要写字，不要渐变和阴影。
prompt.en: Tile a 16:10 canvas with one half-disc shape at a fixed horizontal and vertical pitch, bleeding all four edges, all in one mid-grey. Then let a circular outline about seventy percent of the canvas height cross those cells. Rotate only the cells the outline passes through by 180 degrees about their own centres and switch them to one greenish tone, leaving every other cell exactly as it was. Do not draw the outline itself, do not set any text, no gradients or shadows.

zh: 重复单元沿一个中心放射排开
en: Repeat one unit around a single center
dz: 单元的角度决定文字的旋转角，越靠外条带越长。
de: The unit's angle sets the text's rotation; the farther out, the longer the bar.
pz: 所有条带从画面外的一个点放射出去，每条里放同一组词标与编号；文字跟着条带一起转，基线始终垂直于条带方向。
pe: Every bar radiates from one point outside the frame, each carrying the same wordmark and number. The text turns with its bar, so the baseline always stays perpendicular to the bar's axis.

caption.zh: 同一个字组，转着排一圈
caption.en: One text group, fanned around a point

observation.zh: 十几条长短不一的色带从画面下方看不见的一点放射出来，每条里都印着同一组词标加编号。关键是文字不是各自找角度摆的：每条的字都跟它所在的那条带一起转，所以字行的方向永远垂直于条带的长边，整组看上去像扇子。
observation.en: A dozen bars of different lengths radiate from a point below the frame, each printed with the same wordmark and number. The crucial part is that the text never picks its own angle: it turns with the bar it sits in, so the line of type is always perpendicular to the bar's long edge, and the set reads as a fan.

zh: 先在画幅外定一个放射中心，通常在正下方，离底边大约画幅高度的四分之一。
从这个点引出若干条带，角度在正负六十度之间均匀铺开，条带的宽度固定、长度各有长短。
把同一组文字放进每条带里，让它跟着这条带的旋转角一起转，不要单独调正。
检查任意一条：字行的方向是否与条带的长边垂直；如果有哪条的字是正的，那条就穿帮了。
en: Fix one radial center outside the frame, usually directly below it, about a quarter of the canvas height below the bottom edge.
Draw the bars out from that point, spread evenly between sixty degrees either side, with a fixed bar width and deliberately uneven lengths.
Place the same text group inside each bar and let it turn with that bar's rotation. Do not straighten it afterwards.
Check any single bar: the line of type must be perpendicular to the bar's long edge. One bar with upright text breaks the whole fan.

exercise.zh: 把一行字和一个编号复制十几份，沿一个画外的中心排成扇面。只允许用一个字号、一种颜色，靠角度和长短的差异做出节奏。做完之后把放射中心连到每条带上画一条辅助线，所有辅助线必须交在同一点。
exercise.en: Copy one line of text plus a number a dozen times and fan them around a center outside the canvas. One size, one colour only; let angle and length carry the rhythm. Then draw a guide from the radial center along each bar: every guide must meet at the same point.

zh: 所有条带的长边延长后是否交于同一个点
每条里的文字是否与自己的条带垂直，没有一条是正的
条带的宽度是否处处一致，长度是否有明显差等
放射中心是否落在画幅之外，让条带看起来是从外面射进来的
en: Do the long edges of every bar meet at one point when extended?
Is the text in each bar perpendicular to its own bar, with none left upright?
Is the bar width uniform everywhere while the lengths clearly vary?
Does the radial center sit outside the frame, so the bars read as arriving from beyond it?

caution.zh: 最常见的错是把文字一个个单独旋转到「好看」的角度。那样每条的字和条带就脱开了，扇面立刻散架。另一个错是让所有条带一样长，节奏全平，放射感也就没了。
caution.en: The usual failure is rotating each text block by eye to whatever looks good. That detaches the type from its bar and the fan falls apart at once. The other failure is giving every bar the same length, which flattens the rhythm and kills the sense of radiation.

prompt.zh: 请做一个扇形的文字版式。在画幅正下方、底边之下约画幅高度四分之一处设一个点，从它出发画十一条等宽的长条，角度从负六十五度到正六十五度均匀分布，条带宽度一致但长度各不相同，靠近中间的几条最长。每条里放同一组内容：一行拉丁词标和一个两位数字，整组跟着条带旋转，字行垂直于条带的长边，文字反白。所有条带同一种主色，图案允许溢出画幅四边。不要渐变、不要阴影、不要背景图。
prompt.en: Build a fanned type layout. Set a point directly below the canvas, about a quarter of the canvas height under the bottom edge, and draw eleven equal-width bars out from it, spread evenly from sixty-five degrees either side. Keep the bar width constant while the lengths vary, the centre bars longest. Each bar carries the same content: one Latin wordmark line and a two-digit number, turned with the bar so the line of type is perpendicular to the bar's long edge, set in reverse. One main colour for every bar, allowed to bleed past all four edges. No gradients, shadows or background image.

zh: 空心大字当底纹，小字压中线
en: Outline the numeral, center the small word
dz: 大数字只留描边做底纹，小字压在它的光学中线上。
de: The numeral keeps only its outline as a ground; the small word sits on its optical middle.
pz: 把数字放得极大但只描边不填色，退成一层底纹；词标缩到很小、只留一行，落在数字的光学中线上，靠颜色而不是字号抢回主角。
pe: Set the numeral enormous but stroke it only, so it drops back into a ground layer. Shrink the wordmark to one small line and land it on the numeral's optical middle, taking the lead back through color rather than size.

caption.zh: 大字退成底纹，小字压在它的中线上
caption.en: A big outline as ground, a small word on its middle

observation.zh: 画面里最大的两个字其实没占主角：它们只描了边，中间是空的，颜色也很淡，看上去像一层底纹。真正的词标很小，只占一行，颜色是全场最重的那一处，而且正落在数字上下的正中间。读者先被颜色抓住，再顺着小字才回头认出大数字。
observation.en: The biggest glyphs on the page are not the lead. They are stroked only, hollow inside and pale, so they read as a ground layer. The real wordmark is tiny, one line, in the heaviest colour on the page, and it lands exactly halfway up the numeral. Colour catches the eye first; only then does the reader follow the small word back and recognise the big number.

zh: 把数字排到几乎占满字面高度，填充关掉只留描边，线宽控制在一个很细的档位。
给这层描边字选一个靠近底色的浅灰，让它退到背景里去，不要和正文抢。
把词标缩到数字高度的十分之一左右，只留一行，字重要够，用全场最重的颜色。
量出数字字面高度的中点，画一条水平辅助线，把词标的垂直中心对到这条线上，再删掉辅助线。
en: Set the numeral almost to the full height of the canvas, turn its fill off, and keep only an outline at a thin stroke weight.
Give that outline a pale grey close to the ground so it retires into the background instead of competing.
Shrink the wordmark to about a tenth of the numeral's height, one line only, at the heaviest weight and colour on the page.
Measure the midpoint of the numeral's cap height, draw a horizontal guide, centre the wordmark on it, then remove the guide.

exercise.zh: 用一个大数字和一行小词标做一张版面：数字只许描边，不许填色，颜色必须比词标浅两档以上；词标的垂直中心必须落在数字字面高度的中点上，误差不超过字面高度的百分之二。
exercise.en: Build a layout from one large numeral and one small wordmark. The numeral may be outlined only, never filled, and must be at least two steps paler than the wordmark. The wordmark's vertical centre must sit on the midpoint of the numeral's cap height, within two percent of that height.

zh: 描边字的颜色是否比小字浅两档以上，退得够不够远
小字是否真的落在字面高度的中点上，而不是靠眼睛估
小字是不是全场唯一的重色，没有第三处在抢
缩到拇指大小，第一眼看到的是小字还是大字
en: Is the outline at least two steps paler than the small word, far enough back?
Does the small word truly sit on the midpoint of the cap height rather than an eyeballed position?
Is the small word the only heavy colour on the page, with nothing else competing?
At thumbnail size, which do you see first, the small word or the big number?

caution.zh: 描边一粗就不再是底纹，会立刻变回主角。空心字的线宽一旦超过字面高度的百分之一，就会开始和小字抢，这层就白退了。
caution.en: Thicken the outline and it stops being a ground and becomes the lead again. Once the stroke passes about one percent of the cap height, it starts competing with the small word and the whole retreat is wasted.

prompt.zh: 请排一张只有大数字和一行小词的版面。数字占满画幅高度的大约九成，只用描边不填色，线宽约为字高的百分之一，颜色用很浅的灰，几乎贴近底色。词标只有一行、大写拉丁，字号约为数字高度的十分之一，用全场最重的颜色，垂直中心严格对齐数字字面高度的中点。背景纯色，不要渐变、阴影、装饰，也不要有第三条文字。
prompt.en: Lay out one large numeral and one small wordmark line, nothing else. The numeral takes about ninety percent of the canvas height, outlined only with no fill, stroke width about one percent of its height, in a very pale grey close to the ground. The wordmark is a single line of uppercase Latin at about a tenth of the numeral's height, in the heaviest colour on the page, its vertical centre aligned exactly to the midpoint of the numeral's cap height. Flat background, no gradient, shadow, ornament or third text element.

zh: 一行里逐字变字号，叠成斜阶梯
en: Size each letter differently, stack them into a slope
dz: 同一行的字母各用不同字号并互相叠压，越走越低。
de: Letters in one line take different sizes and overlap, stepping downward as they go.
pz: 一行字里每个字母的字号都不一样，后面的字母压住前面那个的一角，整行就斜着往下走；数字接着这条斜线，用同一副衬线收尾。
pe: Give every letter in the line its own size and let each overlap the corner of the one before it, so the line steps down on a slope. The numeral picks up that slope and closes it in the same serif.

caption.zh: 每个字母一个字号，压着往下走
caption.en: One size per letter, overlapping on a slope

observation.zh: 这行字母不是一套字号排下来的：每个字母的档位都不一样，越往后越大，基线也一档一档往下掉，相邻的字母还互相压住一角。整行因此不再是水平的一条，而是斜着走的一条阶梯。最后的数字用同一副衬线，把这条斜线接了下去。
observation.en: This line was not set at one size. Each letter takes its own step, growing as it goes, while the baseline drops a notch each time and neighbouring letters overlap at the corner. The line stops being horizontal and becomes a staircase on a slope. The final numeral picks that slope up in the same serif and carries it out.

zh: 先定一个字号递增的档位，比如每个字母比前一个大一到两成，六个字母就是一串固定的比例。
让每个字母的基线比前一个下移一个固定值，下移量约为字面高度的两成，别超过三成。
把字距收紧到负值，让每个字母都压住前一个的一角；压的深度保持一致。
最后一个数字的字号和位置接着这条斜线走，用与词标同一副衬线，不要另换字体。
en: Fix a size progression first, each letter ten to twenty percent larger than the last, so six letters form one settled ratio.
Drop each letter's baseline by a fixed amount, about a fifth of the cap height, never more than a third.
Tighten the tracking into negative values so every letter overlaps the corner of the one before it, and keep the overlap depth even.
Let the final numeral continue that slope at its own size, in the same serif as the wordmark. Do not switch faces.

exercise.zh: 用六个字母和一个数字排一行：字母逐个放大、逐个下沉、逐个叠压，数字收尾。做完把这行旋转回水平看一眼——如果变成水平后字号变化显得很突兀，说明台阶给得太大。
exercise.en: Set one line of six letters plus a numeral: each letter larger, lower and overlapping the last, with the numeral closing it. Then rotate the line back to horizontal and look again. If the size jumps look crude at level, your steps are too big.

zh: 字号是否真的逐字递增，没有一个是回头的
基线下沉量是否每一步都一样
字母叠压的深度是否均匀，没有一处咬得太深
最后的数字是否和词标同一副衬线，斜线接得上
en: Does the size truly increase letter by letter, with none stepping back?
Is the baseline drop identical at every step?
Is the overlap depth even, with nowhere biting in too deep?
Is the final numeral in the same serif, so the slope joins up?

caution.zh: 台阶给得太大就散架，读者只会觉得这一行是没排好。字号差控制在每步一到两成，全行总差不超过三倍。叠压也别太深，压到认不出字母就只剩一团黑。
caution.en: Steps that are too large break the line apart and read as bad setting. Keep each step to ten or twenty percent and the whole line under a threefold span. Do not overlap so deep that letters become unreadable; past that point it is just a smear of ink.

prompt.zh: 请排一行大写拉丁词标，六个字母，每个字母比前一个大约百分之十五，基线每步下沉字高的五分之一，字距收到负值让相邻字母各压住一角，压的深度一致。词标之后紧接一个两位数，字号最大，用与词标完全相同的衬线，接着这条斜线收尾。全部用一种深色，背景浅色，不要描边、投影、渐变或装饰。
prompt.en: Set one line of six uppercase Latin letters, each about fifteen percent larger than the one before, the baseline dropping a fifth of the cap height per step, tracking tightened into negative values so neighbouring letters overlap at one corner by an even depth. Close the line with a two-digit number at the largest size, in exactly the same serif, continuing the slope. One dark colour on a light ground, no outline, shadow, gradient or ornament.

zh: 用一整根等粗的线写字母
en: Draw the letters with one even-weight line
dz: 字母由一根等粗的连续线描出，笔画可以互相穿插。
de: The letters are traced by one continuous even-weight line whose strokes may cross.
pz: 字的骨架是一根从头走到尾的线，线宽始终不变、转角一律圆化；笔画之间可以互相穿过，整个字标看起来像一根弯过的铁丝。
pe: The whole letterform is one line walked end to end at a constant width, every corner rounded, strokes free to cross each other, so the wordmark reads as a single piece of bent wire.

caption.zh: 一根线走完整个字标
caption.en: One wire, walked through the whole wordmark

observation.zh: 字的粗细从头到尾一模一样：竖、横、弧、转弯，全是同一根线。没有粗细对比，也没有衬线的收尾，转角一律是圆的。笔画之间是穿过去的，所以看上去像一根铁丝被弯成了字，而不是用笔写的。
observation.en: The weight is identical from end to end. Stems, bars, arcs and turns are all the same single line. There is no thick-thin contrast and no serif finish, and every corner is rounded. Strokes simply pass through each other, so it reads as one piece of wire bent into letters rather than something written with a pen.

zh: 先只画骨架：一条贯穿全字的中心线，从起点一直走到终点，中途不抬笔。
给这条线定一个固定的线宽，大约为字面高度的百分之十，全字不再改动。
所有转角一律圆化，线头也做圆头，不要出现任何尖角或平头。
让笔画在同一处交叉穿过，不做断开也不做留白；检查一遍线宽，任何一处变粗变细都要改回去。
en: Draw the skeleton only: one centre line that walks from the start of the wordmark to the end without lifting.
Give that line a fixed weight, roughly ten percent of the cap height, and never change it again.
Round every corner and both line ends. No points, no flat cuts.
Let strokes cross straight through each other with no breaks or gaps, then sweep the whole line checking the weight. Any thick or thin spot has to be corrected.

exercise.zh: 用一根等粗的线把一个词写完，中途不许抬笔、不许换线宽。写完后把图缩小到拇指大小：线宽如果还能保持均匀，说明这根线立住了；哪一段变糊，就是那里笔画挤得太密。
exercise.en: Write one word with a single even-weight line, never lifting the line and never changing its weight. Then shrink it to thumbnail size: if the weight still reads even, the line holds. Wherever it muddies, the strokes are packed too closely there.

zh: 整根线是否处处等粗，弧段没有变细
转角是否全部圆化，没有残留的尖角或平头
笔画相交处是否直接穿过，没有断开或留白
缩到拇指大小，线宽是否还读得均匀
en: Is the line the same weight throughout, with no thinning around the curves?
Are all corners rounded, with no leftover points or flat cuts?
Do crossing strokes pass straight through, with no breaks or gaps?
At thumbnail size, does the weight still read as even?

caution.zh: 等粗的线一旦在某处变细，整根线就断了气。最容易出错的是弧线外侧和急转弯，那里需要手动补回宽度。另外别用它写太长的词：字一多，交叉跟着多，很快就会糊成一团。
caution.en: The moment the line thins anywhere, the whole thing loses its tension. The usual offenders are the outer side of curves and tight turns, where width has to be pushed back by hand. Do not use it for long words either: more letters means more crossings, and it muddles fast.

prompt.zh: 请用一根等粗的连续线画一个拉丁大写字母，线宽为字面高度的十分之一，从头到尾不许变化；所有转角圆化，线头圆头，笔画相交处直接穿过不做断开。只用一种深色、纯描边不填充，背景浅色，不要描边效果的阴影、渐变或任何装饰。
prompt.en: Draw one uppercase Latin letter with a single continuous even-weight line, its weight a tenth of the cap height and constant from start to finish. Round every corner and both ends, and let strokes cross straight through without breaking. One dark colour, stroke only, no fill, on a light ground. No stroke effects, shadows, gradients or ornament.

zh: 字的透视和放射线共用一个消失点
en: Perspective type and rays share one vanishing point
dz: 文字做透视拉伸，底下的放射线必须收在同一个点。
de: The type stretches in perspective; the rays behind it must converge on the same point.
pz: 一行字沿纵深拉伸，近大远小；画面里的放射线不能自己找角度，必须和文字共用同一个消失点，两层才咬得死，否则字就像贴上去的。
pe: A line of type is stretched into depth, large near and small far. The rays behind it cannot pick their own angle: they must converge on the same vanishing point, or the layers never lock and the words look pasted on.

caption.zh: 字和线收在同一个点上
caption.en: Type and rays meeting at one point

observation.zh: 一行字被送进了纵深：靠近画面左边时又高又大，往右一路收窄变小。它底下那些放射线不是随便撒的，把它们延长回去，全都交在同一个点上，也就是文字收拢的那个点。因为共用这一个点，字和背景才是同一套空间。
observation.en: A line of type has been pushed into depth: tall and large near the left edge, narrowing and shrinking toward the right. The rays underneath are not scattered at will. Extend them and they all meet at one point, the same point the type converges on. Sharing that single point is what makes type and background one space.

zh: 先定消失点，放在画幅外或画幅一端都行，位置一旦定了不许再挪。
画一条穿过消失点的水平轴线，把文字带的高度按轴线上各点的远近定下来：近端高、远端低。
把文字带做成一个从近到远收窄的梯形，两端的字高按比例差开，近端的字明显大、远端明显小。
从消失点向画面外拉放射线，每条线都严格经过这个点；拉完把辅助的延长线擦掉，检查有没有哪一条偏了。
en: Fix the vanishing point first, either outside the canvas or at one end of it, and never move it again.
Draw a horizontal axis through that point and derive the type band's height at each distance from it: tall near, low far.
Shape the type band as a taper that narrows with distance, and scale the words at either end to match, clearly large near and clearly small far.
Pull the rays out from the vanishing point, each one passing strictly through it. Erase any construction lines and check that none of the rays drifts off the point.

exercise.zh: 做一张有纵深的文字版面：先定一个画外的消失点，再从它拉出十条以上的放射线，然后让一行字沿这些线的收拢方向由大变小。做完把每条放射线反向延长，它们必须交在同一点上，差一点都不算过。
exercise.en: Build a type layout with depth. Fix a vanishing point outside the canvas, pull ten or more rays from it, then let one line of type shrink along the direction those rays converge. When you are done, extend every ray backwards: they must all meet at one point. Anything short of that fails.

zh: 所有放射线反向延长后是否严格交于一点
文字带近端与远端的高度比，是否与两端到消失点的距离比一致
字号的变化方向是否和线的收拢方向一致
有没有哪条线的角度是另找的，破坏了同一个空间
en: Do all rays meet at exactly one point when extended backwards?
Does the height ratio between the near and far ends of the band match the distance ratio to the vanishing point?
Does the size change run the same way the rays converge?
Is any single ray set at its own angle, breaking the one space?

caution.zh: 最常见的错是文字和放射线各画各的，两者收在不同的点上，远看像把字贴在了背景上。消失点只能有一个，也不能中途换；另外远端别缩得太小，小到读不出字母就只剩装饰了。
caution.en: The usual failure is drawing type and rays independently so they converge on different points; from a distance the words look pasted onto the background. There is only one vanishing point and it cannot change midway. Do not over-shrink the far end either: once letters stop reading, it is decoration.

prompt.zh: 请做一张有纵深感的排版。消失点定在画幅右侧之外，从它向画面拉出十三条白线做放射底。一条水平方向的文字带从左侧向右侧收窄，带子高度从占画幅一半收到占画幅八分之一。带子近端放一行大写拉丁词标，字号按带子高度取满；远端放一个两位数，字号同样按那里的带子高度取。两者用同一个颜色，都是反白。深色背景，不要渐变、阴影、图案。
prompt.en: Build a layout with real depth. Put the vanishing point outside the canvas to the right and pull thirteen white rays from it as the background. A horizontal type band narrows from left to right, its height falling from half the canvas to an eighth. At the near end set one line of uppercase Latin sized to fill the band there; at the far end set a two-digit number sized to fill the band at that point. Both in the same colour, reversed out. Dark ground, no gradient, shadow or pattern.

zh: 同一串字逐档试排定字号
en: Size a line by test-setting it
dz: 字号不靠手感，靠这串字在栏里排成几行来定。
de: Size is not taste: it is how many lines the string takes inside the column.
pz: 把副标题按三档字号各排一遍，叠在同一栏宽里比：留下正好两行、两行都撑到栏线的那一档。
pe: Set the subtitle at three sizes, stack them inside one column and compare. Keep the step that fills the column in exactly two lines.

caption.zh: 副标题在栏宽里逐档试排
caption.en: Test-setting the subtitle inside the column

observation.zh: 同一句副标题在画面里出现了三四个副本，字号一档比一档大，都压在同一个栏宽内。最后留下的那档排成两行，两行的右边缘几乎顶住栏线；试排时偏小的那档两行都短一截，偏大的那档折成了三行。
observation.en: The same subtitle appears three or four times at rising sizes, all inside one column. The step that survives sets in two lines whose right edges almost touch the column edge. The smaller trial leaves both lines short; the larger one breaks into three lines.

zh: 先量出栏宽，或者先画两条竖线把栏定死。
把副标题按三到四档字号各排一遍，叠在同一栏里比。
留下正好两行、并且两行都接近栏宽的那一档；一行太空、三行太碎都不算。
字号定下来之后再回填主标题，让主标题明显压过它一档以上。
en: Measure the column first, or draw two vertical rules and lock it.
Set the subtitle at three or four sizes and stack the results inside that column.
Keep the step with exactly two lines whose right edges both come close to the column. One loose line or three broken lines do not count.
Only then bring the main title back in, a clear step or more above the settled subtitle.

exercise.zh: 拿一句 8 到 14 个字的副标题，在同一栏宽里试排三个字号，留下正好两行、两行等长的那一档，再和随手取的默认字号比一次。
exercise.en: Take an 8 to 14 character subtitle and test it at three sizes inside one column. Keep the step that sets in exactly two near-equal lines, then compare it with the size you would have picked by default.

zh: 留下的那档是不是正好两行，没有一行或三行的版本
两行的右边缘是不是都接近栏线，没有一行短一截
主标题是否比定下来的副标题至少大一档
en: Does the kept step give exactly two lines, not one and not three?
Do both lines reach close to the column edge instead of one falling short?
Is the main title at least one clear step above the settled subtitle?

caution.zh: 别为了凑满栏宽把两行拆得长短悬殊，两行长度要接近；也不要只试一档就定，至少三档才看得出差别。
caution.en: Do not stretch the column by making one line much longer than the other; the two lines should come out close. And never settle on one trial: three steps are the minimum to see a difference.

prompt.zh: 请排一张只有主标题和副标题的封面：先画出一条明确的栏宽，把副标题放进栏内，按三档不同字号各排一遍并叠在一起做比较，挑出正好排成两行、两行长度都接近栏宽的那一档作为最终字号；主标题比它大至少一倍，与副标题共用同一条左边缘。只输出最终这一版，不要保留试排的副本。
prompt.en: Lay out a cover with only a main title and a subtitle. Draw one explicit column first, place the subtitle inside it, then set that subtitle at three different sizes and stack the results for comparison. Keep the step that sets in exactly two lines whose lengths both come close to the column, and use it as the final size. The main title should be at least twice as large and share the subtitle's left edge. Output only the final version, with the trial copies removed.

zh: 下划线占位让著译同列
en: Leader gaps put the role words in one column
dz: 署名行先用等宽下划线占位，再把它们换成空白。
de: Reserve each gap with a fixed-width leader, then swap the leaders for blank space.
pz: 名字后面先打下等宽的下划线，把「著」「译」推到同一条竖线上；定稿时删掉下划线只留空白，列位不变。
pe: Type a fixed-width run of underscores after each name so the role words land on one vertical line, then delete the underscores for the final and keep the columns.

caption.zh: 署名与角色词按列对齐
caption.en: Names and role words on fixed columns

observation.zh: 署名行里两个名字后面各有一段下划线，两段长度不同。它们的用处不是装饰，而是先把不定宽的间隙撑成一个定宽，让「著」和「译」落在同一条竖线上；定稿时下划线被删掉，只留空白，两个角色字的位置没有移动。
observation.en: In the credit line each name is followed by a run of underscores, and the two runs differ in length. They are not decoration: they turn a variable gap into a fixed one so the role words land on a single vertical line. In the final version the underscores are gone, only blank space remains, and the role words have not moved.

zh: 把署名行写成「名字—间隔—角色词」的结构，角色词只用一两个字。
在每个名字后面打下等宽的下划线，一直打到两个角色词的左边缘对齐。
量出下划线的实际宽度，定稿时用等宽空白替换掉它们。
角色词后面不要再补空格，多一个空格列位又会跑。
en: Write the credit line as name, gap, role word, with the role word kept to one or two characters.
Type a run of underscores after each name until the role words share one left edge.
Measure the width those runs actually take, then replace them with equal blank space for the final.
Add nothing after the role words: a single extra space pushes the column off again.

exercise.zh: 找一条三人的署名行（著、译、校），用下划线把三个角色词推到同一竖列，再把下划线换成空白，核对列位有没有移动。
exercise.en: Take a three-person credit line (author, translator, proofreader) and use underscore runs to push the three role words onto one vertical line. Swap the underscores for blank space and check whether the column held.

zh: 两个角色词的左边缘是否落在同一条竖线上
下划线换成空白之后列位是否没有移动
名字最长的那一项是否把角色词挤跑，需要换行或调整结构
en: Do the role words share one left edge?
Did the positions hold after the underscores were replaced by blank space?
Does the longest name push its role word out of the column, meaning the line needs to break or restructure?

caution.zh: 下划线只是量具，成品里必须删掉；名字长短差距过大时不要硬撑，宁可按规则改成名字在前、角色词另起一列。
caution.en: The underscores are only a measuring tool and must be deleted in the final. If the names differ wildly in length, do not force the line: give the role words their own column instead.

prompt.zh: 请做一条三人的署名行（著、译、校）：先在每个名字后面打下等宽下划线，把三个角色词推到同一条竖列上对齐，再把下划线替换成等宽空白；整行齐左，不要用空格手动对齐，也不要留下任何下划线。
prompt.en: Build a three-person credit line for author, translator and proofreader. First type a run of underscores after each name so the three role words line up on a single vertical column, then replace those runs with equal blank space. Keep the whole line flush left, never align it with typed spaces, and leave no underscores behind.

zh: 黄金比切分上下两块
en: Split two stacked blocks at 1.618
dz: 整组高度按 1.618 分成上下两段，上段占大份。
de: The whole stack splits at 1.618 into an upper and a lower block; the upper takes the larger share.
pz: 上线与下线之间是整组文字，中间一横把它切成 1.618 : 1；上段放主张与数字，下段放补充说明，比例即刻可读。
pe: One rule cuts the text stack at 1.618 : 1. The upper block carries the claim and its number, the lower the supporting note; the ratio alone orders them.

caption.zh: 1.618 与 1 的上下分块
caption.en: A 1.618 : 1 stacked split

observation.zh: 上下两段的边界由一条水平线给出，上段高度约为下段的 1.618 倍；两段各自是一组「一句说明加一个大数字」。
observation.en: A single horizontal rule marks the boundary. The upper block measures about 1.618 times the lower, and each block is a text line paired with a large numeral.

zh: 先把上下两段的内容各写成一组：一段主张加一个数字，一段补充加一个数字。
量出两组加起来的整段高度 H，在 0.618H 处画一条水平线。
把上组的下缘压在这条线上，下组从线的下方开始。
通看一遍：上组是否明显大于下组，若两段看着一样高，说明字号档位没拉开。
en: Write the two blocks first: one claim plus its numeral, one supporting note plus its numeral.
Measure the total stack height H and draw a horizontal rule at 0.618H.
Sit the upper block's bottom edge on that rule and start the lower block just below it.
Read it back: if the two blocks look equally tall, the size steps between them are not far enough apart.

exercise.zh: 拿一条有两个卖点的产品信息，给主张与补充各配一个数字，用一条落在 0.618 处的横线把整组切开。
exercise.en: Take a product blurb with two selling points, give each one a numeral, and cut the whole stack with a single rule placed at 0.618.

zh: 分割线是否只有一条，且贯穿整组宽度
上下两段的字号档位是否至少差两级
en: Is there exactly one dividing rule, spanning the full width of the stack?
Do the two blocks differ by at least two size steps?

caution.zh: 黄金比是给「两组体量」用的，不是给每一行字用的；把它套到行距或字距上只会得到一堆无意义的数字。
caution.en: The golden ratio orders two masses, not every line. Applying it to leading or letter spacing just produces meaningless numbers.

prompt.zh: 做一张只有上下两块的版式：上块是一句主张加一个两位数字，下块是一句补充加一个一位数字；用一条贯穿整组宽度的水平线把整组按 1.618 : 1 切开，上块占大份。全图只用黑色与浅灰底，不要装饰线、图标或色块。
prompt.en: Build a layout with just two stacked blocks. The upper is a claim plus a two-digit number; the lower is a supporting note plus a single digit. Cut the whole stack with one rule spanning its full width at 1.618 : 1, the upper taking the larger share. Black on pale grey only; no ornaments, icons or colour blocks.

zh: 最小的数值放到最大
en: Set the smallest number largest
dz: 9W 是全表最小的参数，却放到整页最大；85% 与 20 倍退成右侧小字。
de: 9W is the smallest figure in the whole spec, yet it takes the page. The 85% and the 20x shrink into a small right-hand column.
pz: 最大的字先被读到，于是最容易被跳过的「9 瓦」成了主张；真正惊人的 85% 与 20 倍降级为佐证，主次被刻意掉了个头。
pe: The largest type is read first, so the easily skipped "9W" becomes the claim while the genuinely impressive 85% and 20x drop to evidence. The hierarchy is deliberately inverted.

caption.zh: 把 9W 做成整页最大
caption.en: Let 9W take the whole page

observation.zh: 三张连续的稿子里，字号最大的始终是 9W，占了版面三分之二；而 85% 与 20 倍被缩成小字，退到右侧排成一列。
observation.en: Across three consecutive frames the largest type is always 9W, filling about two thirds of the page, while 85% and 20x shrink and retreat into a narrow column at the right.

zh: 把该产品的所有数值列出来，按「读者以为重要」的顺序排一遍。
挑出排在最末、最容易被跳过的那一个，例如 9W。
把它放到整页最大，占满版面宽度的三分之二以上。
其余数值统一缩到主数字的三分之一以下，靠边排成竖列。
通读一遍：如果读者第一句说出来的还是 85%，说明主数字放得不够大。
en: List every figure on the product and rank them by what a reader expects to matter.
Pick the one that ranks last, the figure everyone skips, for example 9W.
Set it as the largest item on the page, filling over two thirds of the width.
Shrink every other figure below a third of that size and stack them in a column at the edge.
Read it back: if the first thing you say is still 85%, the main figure is not large enough.

exercise.zh: 找一个有三个以上数值的商品页，把最小的那个放大到占三分之二版面，其余全部降成小字注脚。
exercise.en: Take any product page carrying three or more figures. Blow the smallest one up to two thirds of the page and demote the rest to small footnote lines.

zh: 主数字是否占版面三分之二以上
其余数值是否都在主数字的三分之一以下
缩小之后是否仍然读得清
en: Does the main figure cover over two thirds of the page?
Are all the other figures below one third of its size?
Are the demoted figures still legible?

caution.zh: 放大的是数值本身，不是它的单位；W、% 这类符号要跟着一起缩档，否则符号会跟数字抢同一个体量。
caution.en: You are scaling the figure, not its unit. Marks like W or % must step down with it, or they will compete at the same mass as the digits.

prompt.zh: 请为「9W LED 灯泡」排一张单页：9W 用最粗字重放到占版面三分之二以上；右侧竖排一列小字，放「省电约 85%」与「寿命是白炽灯的 20 倍」，字号不超过主字的三分之一。只要黑白，不要图片和装饰。
prompt.en: Lay out a single page for a 9W LED bulb. Set 9W in the heaviest weight across more than two thirds of the page. In a narrow column at the right, stack "saves about 85%" and "lasts 20x longer than incandescent", at no more than a third of the main size. Black and white only, no imagery or ornament.

zh: 巨字退成浅灰底纹
en: Drop the giant glyph to a pale ground
dz: 巨字与正文叠在一起时，把巨字压到浅灰，正文才读得出来。
de: When a giant glyph and body copy overlap, push the glyph down to pale grey so the copy can be read.
pz: 先是黑字压黑字，交叉处糊成一片；把巨字降到浅灰，它就从主角变成底纹，正文落在它上面，前后关系立刻分开。
pe: Black on black first: where they cross, both die. Drop the glyph to pale grey and it stops being the subject and becomes ground; the copy sits on top and the depth order is immediate.

caption.zh: 巨字降到浅灰，正文才站得住
caption.en: Ghost the giant glyph so the copy can stand

observation.zh: 两张相邻稿只差一件事：巨字从纯黑变成浅灰。黑的那张里，叠上去的说明句子在笔画交叉处断成几截；浅灰的那张里，同一句话完整可读。
observation.en: The two frames differ in one thing: the giant glyph goes from solid black to pale grey. In the black version the overlaid sentence breaks apart where it crosses a stroke; in the grey version the same sentence reads whole.

zh: 先把巨字正常排出，让它占满版面。
把说明段落摆好，记下它与笔画重叠的位置。
把巨字的明度降到正文与底色之间的中间值，明显低于正文的对比度。
逐个交叉点检查：只要有一处正文与笔画糊在一起，就再降一档明度。
en: Set the giant glyph normally so it fills the page.
Place the copy block and note where it crosses the strokes.
Drop the glyph's lightness to a value between the copy and the background, clearly below the copy's contrast.
Walk every crossing: if any spot still muddles the copy into a stroke, drop the glyph one more step.

exercise.zh: 用一个大写字母或一个大数字做底纹，上面压两行说明文字，把底纹字的明度调到「读得清正文、仍看得出字形」的那一档。
exercise.en: Use one large letter or numeral as ground, lay two lines of copy over it, and tune the glyph's lightness until the copy is legible yet the letterform is still recognisable.

zh: 每一处笔画交叉点的正文是否都完整可读
底纹字是否仍能辨认出字形
底纹字是否已不再是画面最重的一块
en: Is the copy complete and readable at every stroke crossing?
Is the ghosted letterform still recognisable?
Is the ghosted glyph no longer the heaviest mass on the page?

caution.zh: 底纹字不能只降一点点。降到「看得清但会分心」是最糟的一档：要么当主角，要么当底纹，中间态没有用。
caution.en: Do not stop halfway. A glyph that is clearly visible yet distracting is the worst setting. It is either the subject or the ground; the middle has no use.

prompt.zh: 请排一张单页：一个巨大的「9W」铺满版面左侧当作底纹，明度压到浅灰，明显低于正文对比度；在它下半部叠两行黑色正文说明。要求正文在任何笔画交叉处都完整可读，底纹字仍能看出字形。不要其他元素。
prompt.en: Build a single page: a huge 9W fills the left side as ground, its lightness pulled to a pale grey clearly below the copy's contrast.
