Overlay two lines of black body copy across its lower half. The copy must read whole at every stroke crossing and the letterform must stay recognisable. No other elements.

zh: 小字挂在主行的基线上
en: Hang the small marks on the main line's baseline
dz: 星期与年份不另起行，缩到小号后直接压在上一行数字的基线上。
de: Weekdays and years do not start a new line; they shrink and sit directly on the baseline of the digits beside them.
pz: 大数字先排定，小字缩到三分之一左右，下缘与大数字的下缘齐平，紧贴在数字右侧的空档里，整行看上去只有一条底线。
pe: Set the large digits first, shrink the small marks to about a third, align their lower edges with the digits' lower edge and tuck them into the gap at the right. The line then reads as one bottom edge.

caption.zh: 星期与年份都落在主行的基线上
caption.en: Weekday and year both land on the main baseline

observation.zh: 「(THU)」「(FRI)」缩到极小，下缘与日期数字的下缘齐平；末尾的「2024」同样缩到极小，下缘与 998 的下缘齐平。没有一处是靠顶部或居中对齐的。
observation.en: (THU) and (FRI) shrink to tiny caps and sit on exactly the same lower edge as the date digits. The trailing 2024 does the same against 998. Nothing is top- or centre-aligned.

zh: 先把日期、价格这类主数字按最大档排好，定下它们的基线下缘。
挑出可以降到附属档的内容：星期、年份、单位、区号。
把这些小字缩到主数字的三分之一左右，把下缘对齐到主数字的下缘。
水平方向贴着主数字右侧的空档排，不要另起一行。
拉一条水平参考线扫过去，所有小字的下缘都应落在这条线上。
en: Set the main figures, dates or prices, at the top size and fix their baseline.
Pick what can drop to the satellite tier: weekday, year, unit, area code.
Shrink those to about a third and bring their lower edges onto the main baseline.
Place them horizontally in the gap at the right of the main figures; do not start a new line.
Sweep a horizontal guide across: every small mark's lower edge should lie on it.

exercise.zh: 排一行日期区间加一行价格，把星期与年份这类附属信息缩到三分之一，全部挂到所在行的基线上，然后拉一条水平线验证。
exercise.en: Set one line of date range and one line of price. Shrink the weekday and the year to a third and hang them all on their own line's baseline, then draw a horizontal guide to check.

zh: 所有小字的下缘是否落在同一条基线上
小字是否都在主数字的三分之一以下
小字与大数字之间是否留了至少半个字宽的间距
en: Do all the small marks land on one baseline?
Are they all below one third of the main size?
Is there at least half a character of clearance to the digits?

caution.zh: 挂上去的小字不能大到与主数字同档，也不能小到看不出属于同一组；它只降一档，不降两档。
caution.en: A satellite that grows to the main size breaks the tier, and one that shrinks too far stops reading as part of the group. Drop it one step, not two.

prompt.zh: 请排两行促销信息：主行是「2024.05.07(THU) - 05.10(FRI)」，第二行是「¥998 2024」。日期与价格用最大档；括号里的星期与末尾的年份缩到三分之一，下缘分别对齐所在行数字的下缘，紧贴数字右侧。黑白单色，不要其他说明文字。
prompt.en: Set two lines of promo copy: "2024.05.07(THU) - 05.10(FRI)" as the main line and "Y998 2024" below it. Dates and price take the top size; the bracketed weekday and the trailing year shrink to a third, their lower edges landing on the baseline of their own line, tucked tight against the digits. Monochrome, no other copy.

zh: 版心由标题字面反推
en: Derive the column from the title's glyph edges
dz: 标题排好后，从它字面的左缘和右缘各引一条竖线，正文与信息块都起止在这对线上。
de: Put a vertical rule on the headline's left and right glyph edges, then let every element start and end on that pair. The column is measured, not chosen.
pz: 不定边距，先把标题排到你要的大小；量出标题字面的左右缘，各引一条通高竖线，正文、信息块、分隔线一律起止在这对线上，版心宽度就等于标题字面宽。
pe: Skip margins. Set the headline at the size you want, then drop a full-height rule from its left glyph edge and another from its right. Body rows, info blocks and dividers all start and end on that pair, so the column width is the headline's optical width.

caption.zh: 标题字面就是版心
caption.en: The headline's glyph edges are the column

observation.zh: 成稿上补画的两条竖线，正好落在标题字面的左右缘；下方每一组信息、每一段正文、每一条分隔线都从这条线开始，到那条线结束。
observation.en: Two rules drawn over the finished poster land exactly on the left and right glyph edges of the headline. Every info block, paragraph and divider below starts on one line and ends on the other.

zh: 先把标题按你要的大小单独排好，不要先定页边距。
在标题字面的最左缘和最右缘各放一条通高竖线，量的是墨迹边缘而不是字号框。
把信息块、正文段落、分隔线的左右两端都吸附到这两条线上。
删掉辅助线再看一遍：所有元素的宽度是否都一样，且都等于标题字面宽。
en: Set the headline alone at the size you want, before choosing any margin.
Place a full-height rule on the leftmost and rightmost ink of the glyphs, not on the font box.
Snap the left and right ends of every info block, paragraph and divider to those two rules.
Hide the guides and check: do all elements share one width, and is it the headline's glyph width?

exercise.zh: 拿一张只有一个标题加三组信息的海报，先排标题，再用标题字面的左右缘定出版心，让三组信息都吃到同一个宽度。
exercise.en: Take a poster with one headline and three info groups. Set the headline first, derive the column from its glyph edges, and make all three groups share that one width.

zh: 两条参考线是否落在字面的墨迹边缘，而不是字号框
删线之后各元素宽度是否仍然一致
en: Do the two guides sit on the ink edges rather than the font box?
With the guides removed, do all elements still share one width?

caution.zh: 标题一换字数或换字体，版心就跟着变；它要求标题长度稳定，短标题配宽版心会露出大片空白。
caution.en: Change the headline's wording or typeface and the column moves with it. It needs a stable headline length; a short headline leaves a wide, empty column.

prompt.zh: 做一张单栏海报：先只排一个超大的拉丁标题，然后在它字面的最左缘和最右缘各拉一条通高竖线，把下方所有信息块、正文段落和分隔线的左右两端都吸附到这对线上，辅助线只在校对时显示。整幅只用黑字与浅灰底，不要边框、图标或色块。
prompt.en: Build a single-column poster: set one oversized Latin headline first, then drop a full-height vertical rule on its leftmost and rightmost glyph edges, and snap every info block, body paragraph and divider below to that pair. Show the guides only while proofing. Use black type on a light grey ground, with no frames, icons or colour blocks.

zh: 侧标长度取大字字面高
en: Size a side caption to the cap height
dz: 两条横线夹出大写的字面高，旁边那列小字的长度就取这个高度，横排竖排都一样。
de: Two rules clamp the cap height of the large word, and the small caption beside it takes exactly that height as its length, set vertically or horizontally.
pz: 先用两条横线夹住大字字面的顶与底，得到一个高度；侧边的说明文字不另定长度——横排就量成这么宽，竖排就排成这么长，字号只留一档。
pe: Clamp the cap of the large word between two rules to get one height. The side caption gets no length of its own: set it horizontally to that width, or vertically to that height, and keep it on a single small step.

caption.zh: 侧标长度等于大写高
caption.en: The side caption measures the cap height

observation.zh: 两条横线夹住大写的字面高；同一段小字横排在字右侧时宽度等于这个高，竖排时行长也等于这个高，两种排法量到同一个长度。
observation.en: Two rules clamp the cap height of the big word. The same small caption matches it as a width when set sideways and as a length when set vertically, so both orientations arrive at one measure.

zh: 排好大字，用两条横线夹住大写字面的顶和底，量出这个高度。
把侧边小字排成横排，调整到宽度正好等于这个高度，超出就换行。
需要竖排时，让这一列字的总长也等于同一个高度。
横竖两版并排看：长度是否一样，一样才说明量的是同一个字面高。
en: Set the large word and clamp its cap between two rules to read the height.
Set the small caption horizontally and tune it until its width equals that height; wrap it if it overruns.
When it has to be vertical, make the column's total length equal the same height.
Compare both versions side by side: identical lengths prove they measure one cap height.

exercise.zh: 给一个单词配一段两个字的说明，横排和竖排各做一版，两版的长度都要等于这个单词大写的字面高。
exercise.en: Pair a single word with a two-word caption, set it both horizontally and vertically, and make both versions measure the word's cap height.

zh: 小字长度是否等于量出的大写字面高
横排与竖排两版长度是否一致
en: Does the caption's length equal the measured cap height?
Do the horizontal and vertical versions measure the same?

caution.zh: 取的是大写的字面高，不是字号；字号里含上下伸部与行距，照字号去量，小字会比大字高出一截。
caution.en: Take the cap height, not the font size. A size includes ascenders, descenders and leading; measure by it and the caption overshoots the big word.

prompt.zh: 做一张只有一个大字和一段侧边说明的图：先用两条横线夹住大字大写的顶与底，再让说明文字的长度等于这个高度——横排放成同宽，竖排放成同长。整幅只用黑字与浅灰底，两条横线用珊瑚色标出，其余元素不上色。
prompt.en: Draw a page with one large word and one side caption: clamp the word's cap between two rules, then make the caption's length equal that height. The same width when horizontal, the same length when vertical. Black type on light grey, the two rules in coral, nothing else coloured.

zh: 中西文按字面高配对
en: Match Chinese and Latin at equal glyph height
dz: 同一字号下汉字看起来比大写字母大，混排时要按字面高对齐，不能按字号。
de: At one nominal size a hanzi looks larger than a capital. In mixed setting, match the two by glyph height instead of by font size.
pz: 用两条横线同时夹住汉字和大写字母：想让它们看起来一样高，就要把汉字那行的字号调小，直到汉字的字面高等于大写高；同字号直接并排，汉字一定冒头。
pe: Clamp a hanzi and a capital between the same two rules. To make them read equal, drop the hanzi's size until its glyph height matches the cap. Set both at one size and the hanzi overshoots.

caption.zh: 汉字与大写等高
caption.en: Hanzi and capital at one height

observation.zh: 两条横线同时切过汉字和拉丁字母，两者的字面顶与底都落在线上；这时候汉字的字号明显小于拉丁那一侧，两边却看着一样大。
observation.en: One pair of rules cuts across both the hanzi and the Latin word, their glyph tops and baselines landing on the same lines. The hanzi is set at a visibly smaller size, yet the two read as equally large.

zh: 把中英两行并排放下，先给同一个字号，看谁冒头。
用两条横线夹住拉丁大写的顶与底，再把汉字也收进这一对线里。
调小汉字那行的字号，直到它的字面高与线距完全吻合。
退后看整行：两种文字的重心是否落在同一条水平线上。
en: Set the Chinese and the Latin line side by side at one size first, and see which one overshoots.
Clamp the Latin cap between two rules, then bring the hanzi into that same pair.
Reduce the Chinese size until its glyph height matches the rule distance exactly.
Step back: do both scripts sit on one optical centre line?

exercise.zh: 写一行「汉字加英文」的短标题，用两条横线把两者的字面高夹到一样，最后得到两个不同的字号。
exercise.en: Write a short heading mixing Chinese and English, clamp both to one glyph height with two rules, and end up with two different font sizes.

zh: 两条横线是否同时切到汉字与拉丁的字面顶和底
两种文字的字号是否已经不再相同
en: Do the two rules touch the glyph top and baseline of both scripts?
Are the two sizes no longer identical?

caution.zh: 反过来按字号对齐，汉字会大一截、整行会跳；混排标题的行距也要按两者中较大的字面高来定。
caution.en: Align by size instead and the hanzi jumps a step larger, breaking the line rhythm. Set the leading from the larger of the two glyph heights.

prompt.zh: 做一张中英混排的短标题：用两条水平参考线夹住拉丁大写的顶与底，再调小汉字那行的字号，让汉字的字面高和拉丁大写高完全相等，两条线同时切到两种字。整幅只用黑字与浅灰底，参考线用珊瑚色。
prompt.en: Set a short bilingual heading: clamp the Latin capital between two horizontal rules, then shrink the Chinese line until its glyph height equals the cap height, with both scripts touching the same pair of rules. Black type on light grey, the rules in coral.

zh: 字面高当字号标尺
en: Cut the cap height into equal type steps
dz: 把主标题的字面高等分成几格，辅助文字的字号取其中一格，整页字号从此能整除复核。
de: Divide the headline's glyph height into equal bands. The auxiliary type takes one band, so every size on the page is an integral fraction of that one height.
pz: 主标题排定后量出它的字面高，用等距横线把这个高切成等分格；小字正好占满其中一格。于是每个字号都是标题字面高的整数分之一，放大缩小都不散。
pe: Measure the headline's glyph height once it is set, then cut that single height with evenly spaced rules. The small type fills exactly one band, so every size on the page is an integral fraction of the headline's height and survives any scaling.

caption.zh: 一组横线排出字号档位
caption.en: One set of rules gives the size steps

observation.zh: 等距横线把主标题的字面高切成平均的几格，最小的一档小字正好吃满其中一格；标尺和文字同框时，每一档都能对着线量出来。
observation.en: Evenly spaced rules divide the headline's glyph height into equal bands, and the smallest type fills exactly one of them. With ruler and type in one frame, every step can be measured against the lines.

zh: 先排定主标题，量出它字面的高度，其余字号都由这一个数推出来。
用等距横线把这个高度切成几格，线画在标题旁边，不要压在字上。
把最小的一档辅助文字调到正好占满其中一格。
更大的档位取两格、三格，得到一组能整除的字号。
移开标尺检查：小字与大字的档位是否还看得出整数关系。
en: Set the headline first and measure its glyph height; every other size derives from that one number.
Cut that height into equal bands with rules drawn beside the headline, not over it.
Tune the smallest auxiliary size until it fills exactly one band.
Take two and three bands for the larger steps, giving sizes that divide evenly.
Remove the ruler and check whether the steps still read as whole-number multiples.

exercise.zh: 拿一段有大标题和三种小字的版面，把大标题的字面高等分成四格，让三种小字分别占一格、两格、三格。
exercise.en: Take a layout with a big headline and three sizes of small type, divide the headline's glyph height into four bands, and give the three sizes one, two and three bands.

zh: 小字是否正好占满一格，没有落在半格上
移开标尺后各档位是否仍成整数倍
en: Does the smallest size fill a whole band, with no half band?
With the ruler gone, are the steps still whole multiples?

caution.zh: 标尺量的是字面高，不含上下伸部与行距；照行高等分，小字会落到半格上。
caution.en: The ruler measures glyph height, not the line box. Divide the line height instead and the small type lands on half a band.

prompt.zh: 做一张字号标尺图：排一个主标题，量出它的字面高，用四条等距横线把这个高切成几格；另外放一档小字，让它正好占满其中一格，再输出一张移开标尺的净版。整幅只用黑字与浅灰底，标尺线用珊瑚色。
prompt.en: Draw a type-scale ruler: set a headline, measure its glyph height, and cut that height into equal bands with four evenly spaced rules. Add one size of small type that fills exactly one band, then output a clean version with the ruler removed. Black type on light grey, the ruler lines in coral.

zh: 整幅按 1.618 切两栏
en: Split the page 1 : 1.618 into two columns
dz: 整幅宽度按 1.618 比 1 切成两栏，窄栏放竖排小字，宽栏放大标题，宽度差就是主次。
de: The full width splits into two columns at 1.618 to 1: the narrow one carries vertical small type, the wide one the headline. The width gap is the hierarchy.
pz: 别先想栏宽，先把整幅宽度按 1.618 比 1 切开：窄栏只放一列竖排小字，宽栏放主标题和一句主张。两栏的宽度差出来的量，就是主次关系的量。
pe: Do not pick column widths by eye. Split the full width at 1.618 to 1: the narrow column carries one vertical line of small type, the wide one the headline and a single claim. The width difference is the hierarchy.

caption.zh: 1.618 比 1 的两栏
caption.en: Two columns at 1.618 to 1

observation.zh: 整个版面的宽度被切成窄宽两栏，比例是 1.618 比 1；窄栏里是一列竖排的特性词，宽栏里是放大后的主标题，两栏的高度没有差别。
observation.en: The full width is cut into a narrow and a wide column at 1.618 to 1. The narrow one holds a vertical line of feature words, the wide one the enlarged headline; their heights are identical.

zh: 量出整幅可用宽度，不要先决定每栏多宽。
在 0.618 的位置画一条竖线，把它切成窄栏与宽栏。
窄栏只放一列竖排小字，字数控制在能排成完整一条的长度。
宽栏放主标题，字号按栏宽定，让标题几乎吃满宽栏。
检查两栏高度是否一致，宽度差是否一眼就能看出主次。
en: Measure the usable width; do not decide either column's width first.
Draw one vertical rule at 0.618 to cut it into a narrow and a wide column.
Put a single vertical line of small type in the narrow column, long enough to read as one strip.
Set the headline in the wide column, sized so it almost fills that width.
Check that both columns share one height and that the width gap alone reads as hierarchy.

exercise.zh: 拿一页产品信息，用 1.618 比 1 切成两栏，窄栏排一列竖排的特性短句，宽栏排主标题与价格。
exercise.en: Take a product page, split it 1.618 to 1, set a vertical column of short feature phrases on the narrow side and the headline plus price on the wide one.

zh: 两栏比例是否为 1.618 比 1
窄栏内容是否排成完整一条，没有断成两截
en: Is the ratio 1.618 to 1?
Does the narrow column read as one continuous strip rather than two fragments?

caution.zh: 窄栏不是留白，是必须填的一条内容；空着不填，这个比例就只剩一条没用的竖线。
caution.en: The narrow column is not leftover space; it has to carry content. Left empty, the ratio becomes a stray vertical rule.

prompt.zh: 做一张两栏页面：把整幅宽度按 1.618 比 1 切成窄栏与宽栏，窄栏排一列竖排的小字特性词，宽栏排一个几乎吃满栏宽的主标题和一句主张；两栏等高、顶边对齐。整幅只用黑字与浅灰底，不要色块，唯一一条竖线用珊瑚色。
prompt.en: Build a two-column page: split the full width at 1.618 to 1 into a narrow and a wide column. The narrow one carries a vertical strip of small feature words, the wide one a headline that nearly fills it plus a single claim. Equal heights, flush tops. Black type on light grey, no colour blocks, the one dividing rule in coral.

zh: 用行带锁住每一行
en: Lock every line onto one band grid
dz: 标题每行用上下两条横线夹出一条行带，再按等距复制到全页，所有文字都落在同一批带里。
de: Each headline line is clamped top and bottom by two rules, and that band repeats at equal pitch down the page. Every element then lands in the same bands.
pz: 先给标题的每一行画出上下两条横线，得到一条行带；再按同样的高度和间距把这条带复制到整页。中英标题、正文、价格数字都吸附进这批带里，右端统一悬挂。
pe: Clamp each headline line between two horizontal rules to get one band, then repeat that band at equal height and pitch across the page. Chinese and Latin titles, body copy and the price all snap into the same set, hanging flush right.

caption.zh: 每一行都在自己的带里
caption.en: Every line sits inside its own band

observation.zh: 标题的第一行被上下两条横线夹成一条带，小标签进这条带；英文标题两行各占一条带；正文三行也落在同一批带上，右端全部对齐。
observation.en: Two rules clamp the headline's first line into a band, and the small label joins it there. The two Latin headline lines take one band each, and the three body lines land in the same set, all flush right.

zh: 先把主标题排出来，用两条横线夹住其中一行的字面顶与底，得到行带的高度。
按这个高度加一个固定间距，向下复制出整页需要的行带。
把小标签放进第一条带，和标题首行共带。
把中英标题、正文、数字都吸附到带上，让字面的顶底与带边齐平。
右端统一悬挂对齐，删掉辅助线，检查每行是否还稳在带上。
en: Set the headline, then clamp one of its lines between two rules to get the band height.
Add a fixed pitch and repeat the band down the page as many times as the layout needs.
Put the small label in the first band, sharing it with the headline's opening line.
Snap the Chinese and Latin titles, the body copy and the numbers into the bands, glyph tops and baselines flush with the band edges.
Hang everything flush right, remove the guides and check that every line still sits in its band.

exercise.zh: 拿一页有中英标题、三行正文和一个价格的版面，先定出一条行带，再复制成整页网格，把所有文字都吸附进去。
exercise.en: Take a page with a bilingual title, three body lines and a price, define one band, repeat it into a full-page grid, and snap every element into it.

zh: 行带高度是否取自标题字面，而不是行高
所有元素，包括数字，是否都落在带上
en: Is the band height taken from the headline's glyphs rather than the line box?
Does every element, the number included, land in a band?

caution.zh: 行带定的是字面的顶和底，间距另外给；把行高当带高用，标题会和正文撞在一起。
caution.en: A band fixes the glyph top and baseline; the gap is set separately. Use the line box as the band and the headline collides with the body.

prompt.zh: 做一页行带网格：先排主标题，用上下两条横线夹住它一行的字面，得到行带高度，再按固定间距把行带复制满整页；中英标题、说明文字和价格数字全部吸附到带上，右端统一悬挂对齐。整幅只用黑字与浅灰底，网格线用珊瑚色，无边框无色块。
prompt.en: Lay out a page on a band grid: set the headline, clamp one of its lines between two rules to get the band height, then repeat the band down the page at a fixed pitch. Snap the bilingual titles, the body copy and the price into the bands, all hanging flush right. Black type on light grey, grid lines in coral, no frames or colour blocks.

zh: 重复小字沿等距基线铺开
en: Spread one repeated line across an even baseline grid
dz: 等距细线当基线，同一组小字逐行错开，主标题压在上面。
de: Evenly spaced hairlines act as baselines; the same small line drops onto each, offset, and the headline sits on top.
pz: 先拉出五条等距细线，把同一组小字逐行放上去并左右错开，形成疏密节奏；主标题的基线落在其中一条线上，整套网格立刻可见。
pe: Rule five hairlines at an even gap, drop the same small line onto each with a sideways offset to build rhythm, then set the headline's baseline on one of those lines so the grid shows through.

caption.zh: 五条等距细线就是一套基线网格。
caption.en: Five hairlines at one gap: that is a baseline grid.

observation.zh: 小字逐行错开，网格才有节奏，不像表格。
observation.en: Offsetting each line keeps the grid from reading as a table.

zh: 按固定间距拉出等距水平细线。
把同一组小字逐行安放，每行左右错开。
让主标题的基线落在其中一条线上。
en: Rule evenly spaced hairlines across the page.
Set the same small line on each one, offset sideways every row.
Land the headline's baseline on one of those lines.

exercise.zh: 用五行以内的字，配同一组小字排一张只有网格的版面。
exercise.en: Set a page whose only structure is the grid, using no more than five lines of type.

zh: 细线间距完全相等。
小字基线正好压在线上。
主标题有一条网格线做靠山。
en: Every hairline gap is identical.
Each small line sits exactly on a rule.
The headline has one rule to stand on.

caution.zh: 间距一旦不匀，整版会散成噪点。
caution.en: Uneven gaps turn the whole page into noise.

prompt.zh: 用等距水平基线网格排一页：拉五条等距细线，把同一组小字逐行放上去并左右错开，主标题基线压在其中一条线上；网格线要细要匀，节奏靠错位而不是靠字号。
prompt.en: Lay out a page on an even baseline grid: rule five equally spaced hairlines, drop the same small line onto each with a sideways offset, and land the headline's baseline on one of them. Keep the rules thin and even; let the rhythm come from offsetting, not from type size.

zh: 小字块宽度当缩进模数
en: Let the small block's width set the indent
dz: 两行小标签的宽度就是一个模数，主标题从这里起排。
de: The two-line label's width is one module; the headline and the line above it start there.
pz: 量出左侧两行小标签的宽度当作一个模数；主标题与上方副行都从这一段宽度之后起排，纵向控制线正好落在标题字面边缘上。
pe: Measure the two-line label on the left and take its width as one module; start both the headline and the line above it one module in, so the vertical rules land on the headline's face edges.

caption.zh: 缩进量不是拍脑袋，是一个小字块的宽度。
caption.en: The indent is not a guess: it is one small block's width.

observation.zh: 控制线落在标题字面边缘，整页只需要量一次。
observation.en: The rules land on the headline's face, so the page is measured once.

zh: 量出小字块的外接宽度。
以此为缩进排主标题与上方副行。
沿主标题字面左右边缘拉纵向控制线。
en: Measure the small block's outer width.
Indent the headline and the line above it by that width.
Draw vertical rules on the headline's left and right face edges.

exercise.zh: 用一条小标签的宽度，把版心两侧的缩进定下来。
exercise.en: Set the indent on both sides of a column from one label's width.

zh: 小字块右缘与主标题左缘同在一条线上。
纵向控制线落在字面上，不在行距里。
en: The label's right edge and the headline's left edge share one line.
The rules land on the glyph edges, not in the leading.

caution.zh: 模数一旦中途改变，控制线就失去意义。
caution.en: Change the module halfway and the rules stop meaning anything.

prompt.zh: 以左侧两行小标签的宽度作为唯一模数排一版：主标题与副行都从这一个宽度之后起排，再沿标题字面左右边缘拉两条纵向细线，全页缩进都从这条线取值。
prompt.en: Set a page with one module: the width of a two-line label on the left. Start both the headline and the sub-line one module in, then draw two vertical hairlines on the headline's face edges and take every indent on the page from those lines.

zh: 按视觉重心对齐，不按外框
en: Align to the optical centre, not the bounding box
dz: 带把手的杯子按外框居中会偏，把视觉重量摆平才稳。
de: Centre a handled mug by its box and it looks off; balance the visual mass instead.
pz: 左边按外接方框居中，把手把重量全拉到右侧；右边让把手与杯身的视觉重量各占一半，杯身自然左移，轴看着才正。
pe: On the left the bounding box is centred and the handle drags all the mass to the right; on the right the handle and the body each take half the weight, so the body shifts left and the axis reads straight.

caption.zh: 外框居中是数学，重心居中才是对齐。
caption.en: Box centring is arithmetic; mass centring is alignment.

observation.zh: 不对称的形状，重量分布决定它看起来正不正。
observation.en: With an asymmetric shape, the mass decides whether it looks straight.

zh: 先找出元素外接方框的中心。
再估出视觉重量真正集中的位置。
把重心而不是外框摆到轴线上。
en: Find the centre of the bounding box.
Then find where the visual weight actually sits.
Put the mass on the axis, not the box.

exercise.zh: 拿一个带把手或带尾巴的图形，用两条轴分别居中对比。
exercise.en: Take any shape with a handle or a tail and centre it twice, once each way.

zh: 轴穿过的是重量，不是外框。
左右两块视觉重量看起来相等。
en: The axis crosses the weight, not the box.
The two sides look equally heavy.

caution.zh: 重心对齐后外框会偏，这是对的，不要拉回去。
caution.en: The box will end up off-centre; that is the point, so do not pull it back.

prompt.zh: 把一个不对称图形（例如带把手的杯子）居中：先画出外接方框中心轴，再把图形整体左移，直到视觉重量在轴两侧均衡，轴不再穿过外框中心；输出带这条轴线的对比图，不要写说明文字。
prompt.en: Centre an asymmetric object such as a handled mug. Draw an axis through the bounding-box centre first, then shift the object left until the visual weight balances across that axis; the axis must no longer pass through the box centre. Show the axis, and keep the drawing free of explanatory prose.

zh: 数字放大，汉字单位降成角标
en: Blow the figures up, demote the unit to a corner tag
dz: 汉字单位缩进方括号贴在数字右下角，主体只剩数字。
de: The unit shrinks into a bracketed tag at the figure's lower right; the figure carries the block.
pz: 把数字放到最大，月、日这类单位缩成方括号小标签贴在数字右下角，原来的整句话退成一行小字当前言。
pe: Set the figure at full size, shrink the unit into a small bracketed tag pinned to its lower right, and let the sentence it came from fall back to one small caption line.

caption.zh: 让数字扛主体，单位退成角标。
caption.en: Let the figure carry the block; the unit becomes a tag.

observation.zh: 单位和数字平起平坐时，谁也读不快。
observation.en: When the unit and the figure weigh the same, neither reads fast.

zh: 挑出真正要传达的数字，放到最大。
把单位缩成方括号小标签，贴到数字右下角。
整句退成一行小字放在数字上方。
en: Pick the figure that carries the message and set it largest.
Shrink the unit into a bracketed tag at the figure's lower right.
Drop the original sentence to one small line above.

exercise.zh: 把一句含数字的话，改成数字主字、单位角标的两层结构。
exercise.en: Rebuild a sentence with a number into two layers: figure first, unit as a tag.

zh: 数字是全版最大的字。
单位比数字小一档以上，且贴着数字的角。
en: The figure is the largest thing on the page.
The unit is a step or more smaller and pinned to the figure's corner.

caution.zh: 单位和数字不要同号，否则两层会重新压平。
caution.en: Keep the unit a size below the figure, or the two layers flatten out again.

prompt.zh: 把一句含数字的文案改成数字主字结构：数字最大，单位（月、日、RMB）缩成小标签贴在其右下角，原句退成一行小字；全版只保留这两层，不加其他装饰。
prompt.en: Rebuild a line of copy as figure-first type: the number largest, the unit shrunk to a small tag pinned to its lower right, the original sentence demoted to one small line. Keep only those two layers and add no other decoration.

zh: 描边字在笔画交汇处断开
en: Break the outline where strokes meet
dz: 空心字描边在交接处会糊成一团，断掉一小段就透气。
de: A hollow glyph clogs where strokes meet; cutting a short gap lets it breathe.
pz: 描边字在笔画交叉和转折处，轮廓会挤成一团黑；在这些位置删掉一小段轮廓，字腔重新透出来，远看仍是完整的描边字。
pe: Where strokes cross or turn, an outlined glyph jams into a blot; delete a short segment of the contour at each of those points so the counters open again, and the word still reads as outlined from a distance.

caption.zh: 断掉交接处的轮廓，空心字才不糊。
caption.en: Cut the contour at the joints and the hollow glyph stops clogging.

observation.zh: 笔画越密，描边越容易连成实心块。
observation.en: The denser the strokes, the faster the outline fills in.

zh: 把字改成描边（空心）状态。
找出笔画交叉与转折处。
在交接点删掉一小段轮廓。
en: Set the word as an outline.
Find where strokes cross or turn.
Delete a short run of contour at each joint.

exercise.zh: 挑三个笔画最密的字，做成描边并逐一断笔。
exercise.en: Take the three densest characters you can find, outline them, and break each joint.

zh: 断口只出现在笔画交接处。
断口宽度一致，边缘干净。
en: Gaps appear only at stroke joints.
Every gap is the same width and clean-edged.

caution.zh: 断得太多就认不出字，断点只留在交接处。
caution.en: Too many gaps and the glyph stops reading; keep the cuts at the joints only.

prompt.zh: 把一个笔画密集的字做成描边字：轮廓等宽，在所有笔画交叉与转折处各删掉一小段轮廓，让交接处透气；断口宽度统一，字整体仍要认得出来。
prompt.en: Set a dense character as an outlined glyph: even contour width, with a short segment of contour deleted at every stroke joint so the crossings can breathe. Keep the gaps one uniform width and the glyph still legible.

zh: 有尖角的字母要探出左边界
en: Hang the pointed letter past the left margin
dz: 按外框对齐，尖角会显缩；让它探出去，边才齐。
de: Aligned by its box a pointed letter looks indented; let it hang and the margin reads straight.
pz: 两行字共用一条左控制线。上一行按 A 的方框对齐，尖角让首字母看着缩进去；下一行把 A 单独往左推，让它跨过控制线，其余字母不动。
pe: Two lines share one left rule. Align the top line by the A's box and its apex reads indented; on the bottom line push only the A left so it crosses the rule, and leave the rest of the word where it was.

caption.zh: 方框对齐会让尖角字母看着缩进去。
caption.en: Box alignment makes a pointed letter look indented.

observation.zh: 圆形与尖形字母两侧的空白天生不对称。
observation.en: Round and pointed letters carry unequal side bearing.

zh: 拉一条左控制线作为边界。
按外框对齐第一行，观察尖角显缩。
把首字母单独左移，跨过控制线。
en: Draw one left rule as the boundary.
Align the first line by its box and watch the apex look short.
Shift the first letter alone left until it crosses the rule.

exercise.zh: 用 A、W、V 开头的三行字，逐个悬挂对齐。
exercise.en: Set three lines starting with A, W and V and hang each one.

zh: 字母跨出的量等于它左侧的空隙。
其余字母仍贴在控制线上。
en: The overhang equals that letter's left side bearing.
The remaining letters still sit on the rule.

caution.zh: 只对尖角或圆弧字母悬挂，方头字母照常对齐。
caution.en: Hang only pointed or rounded letters; flat-sided ones stay aligned.

prompt.zh: 排两行共用一条左控制线的字：上一行按外框对齐，下一行把首字母（A、W、V 这类有尖角的）单独左移跨过控制线，其余字母不动，并在两行之间标出跨出的量。
prompt.en: Set two lines on a shared left rule. Align the top line by the bounding box; on the bottom line move only the first letter (an A, W or V) left until it crosses the rule, leaving the rest in place, and mark the overhang between the two lines.

zh: 按钮尺寸从字高按倍数推
en: Derive the button from the cap height
dz: 设字高为 a，上下留白取 1.5a，横向余量取 2a。
de: Take the cap height as a; the vertical padding is 1.5a and the sideways slack 2a.
pz: 先量出文字高度记作 a，把上下留白定成 a 的 1.5 倍，横向余量定成 a 的两倍，胶囊的圆角与总高都由这套倍数算出来，不再靠眼估。
pe: Measure the cap height as a, set the vertical padding to 1.5a and the sideways slack to 2a, and let those multiples produce the pill's height and radius instead of eyeballing them.

caption.zh: 控件的每一维都从字高算出来。
caption.en: Every dimension of the control comes off the cap height.

observation.zh: 同版按钮大小不一，多半是留白靠估。
observation.en: Buttons that disagree in size usually got their padding by eye.

zh: 量出文字的字面高度 a。
上下留白取 1.5a，横向余量取 2a。
由这套倍数推出圆角与总高。
en: Measure the face height as a.
Set vertical padding to 1.5a and horizontal slack to 2a.
Derive the height and radius from those multiples.

exercise.zh: 用同一个 a 排出三个不同文字的按钮，验证它们等高。
exercise.en: Set three buttons with different labels from one a and check they match in height.

zh: 留白是字高的整数或半数倍。
换文案后控件尺寸不跳。
en: Padding is a whole or half multiple of the cap height.
Changing the label does not change the control's size.

caution.zh: a 取的是字面高度，不是字号。
caution.en: a is the face height, not the font size.

prompt.zh: 用字高做模数设计一个胶囊按钮：量出文字字面高度 a，上下留白 1.5a，横向余量 2a，圆角与总高都由这些倍数推出；输出带 a、1.5b、2a 三个量度标注的示意图。
prompt.en: Design a pill button on a cap-height module: measure the face height as a, set vertical padding to 1.5a and horizontal slack to 2a, and derive height and radius from those multiples. Output a diagram annotated with a, 1.5b and 2a.

zh: 数字里的冒号连字符要上移
en: Lift the colon and hyphen inside figures
dz: 符号守在基线上会往下坠，抬到数字高度中线才平。
de: Marks left on the baseline sag; raised to the midline of the figures they read level.
pz: 20:00-22:00 里的冒号与连字符默认坐在基线上，比数字中心低一截；把它们上移到数字的高度中线，整串数字才在视觉上居中。
pe: In 20:00-22:00 the colon and hyphen sit on the baseline, a notch below the middle of the figures; raise them onto the figure midline and the whole run sits optically centred.

caption.zh: 标点不占字面高度，默认位置必然偏低。
caption.en: Marks do not fill the figure height, so the baseline leaves them low.

observation.zh: 同一串数字里，符号比数字矮，天然显得下坠。
observation.en: Inside one run the marks are shorter than the figures and read as sagging.

zh: 排出一串含冒号与连字符的数字。
找出数字字面的高度中线。
把符号整体上移到那条中线。
en: Set a run of figures with a colon and a hyphen.
Find the midline of the figure height.
Raise the marks onto that line.

exercise.zh: 把一组时间区间排两遍，一遍守基线，一遍抬符号。
exercise.en: Set one time range twice: marks on the baseline, then marks raised.

zh: 所有符号在同一高度，不出现一高一低。
抬升后整串数字上下留白相等。
en: All marks sit at one height, not two.
After the lift the run's top and bottom space match.

caution.zh: 抬升量按字面高度算，不要凭眼看。
caution.en: Compute the lift from the figure height; do not do it by eye.

prompt.zh: 把 20:00-22:00 这类数字组里的冒号和连字符从基线抬到数字字面高度的中线，让整串数字光学居中；输出标注基线、中线与抬升量的示意图，不要说明文字。
prompt.en: Raise the colon and hyphen in a figure run such as 20:00-22:00 from the baseline to the midline of the figure height so the run reads optically centred. Output a diagram marking the baseline, the midline and the lift, with no explanatory prose.

zh: 汉字占两格，西文占一格
en: Two units for the hanzi, one for the Latin
dz: 量汉字字面高记作 2A，西文字面取 A，两行才配得上。
de: Measure the hanzi face as 2A and set the Latin face to A; only then do the two lines match.
pz: 把汉字字面高度记作 2A，西文的字面高度取 A，两行各自落在自己的倍数上；中英并置时大小观感才一致，而不是都设同一个字号。
pe: Take the hanzi face height as 2A and the Latin face height as A, so each line sits on its own multiple; that is what makes the two scripts look the same size, not giving them one shared font size.

caption.zh: 字号相同不代表看起来一样大。
caption.en: The same font size does not look the same size.

observation.zh: 汉字占满字身，西文只占字面，同号必然西文偏小。
observation.en: Hanzi fills its em; Latin does not, so equal size leaves the Latin small.

zh: 量出汉字字面高度，记作 2A。
把西文字面高度定成 A。
两行各自按自己的倍数落位。
en: Measure the hanzi face and call it 2A.
Set the Latin face height to A.
Place each line on its own multiple.

exercise.zh: 用同一段中英对照文字，先同号排一遍，再按 2:1 字面对齐排一遍。
exercise.en: Set one bilingual pair at a shared size, then at a 2:1 face ratio, and compare.

zh: 两行字面高度比接近 2:1。
西文没有靠加粗去补偿。
en: The two face heights land near 2:1.
The Latin is not compensated by extra weight.

caution.zh: 比值按字面算，不按字号；不同字体字面占比不一样。
caution.en: Compute the ratio from the face, not the font size; faces differ between families.

prompt.zh: 排一行中英对照：量出汉字字面高度作为 2A，把西文与数字的字面高度定成 A，使两行看起来一样大；输出带 2A / A 标注的示意图，不要写说明文字。
prompt.en: Set one bilingual line: measure the hanzi face as 2A and set the Latin and figures to a face height of A so both lines look the same size. Output a diagram annotated 2A and A, with no explanatory prose.

zh: 立三根纵轴再排字
en: Stand three vertical axes, then hang the type
dz: 版面先立几根纵轴，每块字各贴一根，横竖混排就站得住。
de: Stand a few vertical axes first and hang each block on one; the mix of standing and running type holds.
pz: 先画三到四条纵向轴线，把标题、西文、说明字各吸到其中一条上：标题贴左轴，西文拆两行居中轴，说明字沿轴宽排满，横竖混排也不散。
pe: Draw three or four vertical axes, then snap each block to one: the title on the left axis, the Latin broken over two lines on the middle one, the credits filling an axis width. Even mixed upright and rotated type holds together.

caption.zh: 没想法时先立轴，字自然有位置。
caption.en: With no idea, stand the axes first and the type finds its place.

observation.zh: 多根轴让横排与竖排能共处一版。
observation.en: Several axes let upright and rotated lines share one page.

zh: 按内容多少定三到四条纵轴。
把每块文字吸到其中一条轴上。
让竖排字与横排字各占一根轴。
en: Set three or four vertical axes to suit the content.
Snap each text block onto one axis.
Give rotated and upright type an axis each.

exercise.zh: 把同一段文案排两遍，一遍无线，一遍加三条纵轴。
exercise.en: Set one block twice: once with no axes, once on three vertical axes.

zh: 每块文字都能指出它贴的是哪根轴。
轴数不超过四条。
en: Every block can name the axis it hangs on.
There are no more than four axes.

caution.zh: 轴太多等于没有轴，四根以内。
caution.en: Beyond four axes there is no axis at all.

prompt.zh: 用纵向轴线编排一版：先立三到四条垂直线，标题贴左轴、西文拆两行居中轴、说明字沿轴宽排满，允许标题竖排；所有文字都必须能指出贴的是哪条轴，轴线保持可见。
prompt.en: Compose a page on vertical axes: stand three or four verticals, hang the title on the left axis, break the Latin over two lines on the middle one, and fill an axis width with the credits. Rotated titles are allowed. Every block must be traceable to one axis, and the axes stay visible.

zh: 大字撑满整组文字的高度
en: Size the display line to the group height
dz: 先定整组的上下界，大字的高度就等于它。
de: Fix the group's top and bottom bounds first; the display line's height equals that distance.
pz: 整组文字先画出上下两条界：顶线取首行的字面顶，底线取末行的基线；大字的高度取这两条界之间的距离，字号由高度反推，不是另外挑一个。
pe: Draw the group's two bounds first: the top rule on the first line's cap height, the bottom rule on the last line's baseline. The display line's height is the distance between them, and its size is solved from that height instead of being picked separately.

caption.zh: 大字的高度与整组文字齐平
caption.en: The display line matching the whole group's height

observation.zh: 一组小字先被两条横线夹住：上面那条压在首行的字面顶上，下面那条压在末行的基线上。旁边那个大字的高度不偏不倚，正好是这两条线之间的距离，上下两端各顶住一条线。把横线撤掉之后，大字和小字组看起来是同一块东西，而不是一个标题加一段说明。
observation.en: Two horizontal rules bracket a small text group: the upper one sits on the first line's cap height, the lower one on the last line's baseline. The large display word beside it is neither taller nor shorter: its height is exactly the distance between those two rules, touching one at each end. Remove the rules and the display word and the small group read as one block, not a headline plus a caption.

zh: 先把小字组排好，定下它的行数和字号，找出最长的那一行。
在首行的字面顶画一条横线，在末行的基线画一条横线，量出两条线之间的距离 H。
取主视觉大字，把它的字面高度调到 H，字号用 H 反推，不要另外挑一个顺眼的字号。
大字与小字组共用同一条竖边，上下两端各顶住一条横线；横线只是量具，定稿时删掉。
en: Set the small group first: fix its line count and size, and find its longest line.
Draw one rule on the first line's cap height and one on the last line's baseline, then measure the distance H between them.
Take the display word and set its cap height to H, solving the size from H rather than picking one that looks nice.
Give the display word the same vertical edge as the small group and let it touch both rules; the rules are only a measuring tool and come off in the final.

exercise.zh: 排一个四行的小字组（标题、副题、说明、日期），画出它的上下界，再用一个两字的大字去填满这个高度，填完把参考线删掉看一次。
exercise.en: Set a four-line group (title, subtitle, note, date), draw its bounds, then fit a two-character display word to that exact height. Delete the guides and look at the result.

zh: 大字的字面顶是否与首行字面顶齐平
大字的字面底是否与末行基线齐平
撤掉参考线后，大字与小字组是否仍读成一块，而不是两个分离的元素
en: Does the display word's cap line match the first line's cap line?
Does its base sit on the last line's baseline?
With the guides gone, do the display word and the group still read as one block rather than two separate elements?

caution.zh: 大字不是「越大越好」：高度超过这两条界，它会压出字组之外，整块就散；不足则中间空出一截，看起来像没对齐。行数太少时（两行以内）这个关系会失效，改回按字面高度定字号。
caution.en: Bigger is not better here. Overshoot the bounds and the word spills past the group; fall short and a strip of dead space opens up. The relation also breaks down on very short groups of one or two lines, where sizing from cap height is the better route.

prompt.zh: 请排一组四行的文字（标题、副题、说明、日期）加一个两字的大字。先画两条横线定出小字组的上下界：上界在首行的字面顶，下界在末行的基线；然后把大字的高度设成这两条线的距离，字号由此反推，大字与小字组共用一条竖边，两端分别顶住上下界。只输出定稿，不要保留参考线。
prompt.en: Lay out a four-line text group (title, subtitle, note, date) with a two-character display word beside it. First rule the group's bounds: the top rule at the first line's cap height, the bottom rule at the last line's baseline. Then set the display word's height to the distance between those rules, solving its size from that height, share one vertical edge with the group, and touch both bounds. Output only the final version, with no guides left in.

zh: 每行都撑到同一条左右边界
en: Every line fills the same two side edges
dz: 最长的一行定宽，其余行补到同宽。
de: The longest line sets the width; every other line is stretched to match it.
pz: 先找出最长的一行，它的左右两端就是文字组的左右边界；其余行要么加字距、要么改字号，让每一行都顶住这两条边界，整组收成一个矩形。
pe: Find the longest line first: its two ends become the group's left and right edges. Every other line is stretched to reach them, by tracking or by resetting its size, until the whole group closes into a rectangle.

caption.zh: 文字组收成一个矩形
caption.en: Closing a text group into a rectangle

observation.zh: 文字组的左右两端被两条竖线夹住，组里每一行都顶住这两条线：短句靠拉开字距补齐，数字行则换一个更大的字号让它刚好排到线。行与行之间除了长短，没有别的差别，整块看起来是一个面，而不是一排参差的句子。
observation.en: Two vertical rules bracket the group and every line inside reaches both. A short phrase is filled out by opening its tracking; a line of figures is reset at a larger size until it just runs to the rule. Apart from length the lines are otherwise equal, so the block reads as one surface instead of a ragged stack.

zh: 把组里所有行排进去，找出最长的一行，用它的左右两端定下两条竖边界。
对短一截的行先加字距：字距均匀加在字与字之间，首尾两字不动。
字距加不下时（比如数字行）改字号：把这一行的字号调大，直到它的两端也顶住边界。
逐行核对两条边界都顶住了，再撤掉参考线；仍有不到边的行就继续加字距或换字号。
en: Set every line of the group, find the longest one, and use its ends to place two vertical rules.
For a short line, open its tracking first: spread the space evenly between the characters and leave the first and last character where they are.
When tracking runs out of room, as with a line of figures, resize instead: raise that line's size until it also reaches both rules.
Check line by line that both edges hold, then take the guides away; any line still short gets more tracking or another size.

exercise.zh: 取一条三行的文字组（一句短语、一行数字、一行日期），用加字距和调字号两种办法，把三行都撑到同一条左右边界上。
exercise.en: Take a three-line group (a phrase, a line of figures, a date) and stretch all three to one shared width, using tracking on one line and a size change on another.

zh: 每一行的左右两端是否都顶住同两条竖边界
加过字距的那一行，字距是否均匀，首尾两字有没有被推离边界
数字行是否靠字号（而不是字距）补齐，避免数字之间裂开
en: Does every line reach both rules?
On the tracked line, is the spacing even, with the first and last characters still on the edges?
Was the line of figures filled by size rather than tracking, so the digits did not drift apart?

caution.zh: 字距只能补一小截，差得太多时硬拉会让一行看起来松垮、和别行的密度不一致；差太多就改字号或改写文案。数字之间拉字距尤其要避免，数字串会被读成两个数。
caution.en: Tracking only closes a small gap; force it over a long one and the line goes slack and stops matching the density of its neighbours. If the gap is large, change the size or rewrite the line. Widely tracked figures are the worst case, since the string starts reading as two separate numbers.

prompt.zh: 请做一组三行的文字（一句短语、一行数字、一行日期），让每一行的左右两端都顶住同两条竖边界，整组收成一个矩形。短句用均匀字距补齐（首尾两字不动），数字行改用字号补齐，不要用字距拉数字。行间距保持一致，只输出定稿，不保留参考线。
prompt.en: Build a three-line group (a phrase, a line of figures, a date) where every line reaches the same two vertical rules, so the group closes into a rectangle. Fill the short phrase with even tracking, leaving its first and last characters in place, and fill the figures by changing their size rather than their spacing. Keep the leading even, and output only the final version without guides.

zh: 小字落在字面基准线上
en: Snap small type to the cap and baseline rules
dz: 位置从大字字面的几条边线里挑一条，不靠目测。
de: The small line's place comes from the display type's cap and baseline rules, not from guesswork.
pz: 先把大字字面的顶线、中线和基线画出来，小字只从这几条线里挑一条落位；换成另一条线，同一段小字的观感就换一次，而间距不是一个随手定的数值。
pe: Draw the display type's cap line, centre line and baseline first, then let the small line land on one of them. Move it to another rule and the same small text reads differently; the gap is never an arbitrary number typed in by hand.

caption.zh: 小字从大字的字面线里挑一条落位
caption.en: Placing small type on one of the display type's rules

observation.zh: 同一个大字旁边，同一段小字被放在几个不同的高度上：有的让字面顶对上大字的字面顶，有的让基线落在大字的基线上，有的落在两者中间。每一版的小字字号都没变，只是落的那条线变了，整组的高低感觉就跟着变。
observation.en: Beside one large word, the same small line is set at several different heights: one version puts its cap line level with the display word's cap line, another drops its baseline onto the display baseline, a third sits halfway between. The small size never changes; only the rule it lands on does, and the whole block reads differently each time.

zh: 选一行大字作为基准，把它的字面顶、字面底和两者的中线各画一条横线，全线通到版面两端。
把小字逐条放到这些线上试：顶对齐、基线对齐、中线对齐，各留一版。
比较这几版的间距观感，挑出一版；挑定之后，小字与大字之间不再留任何手工加的间距。
同组的其它小字沿用同一条基准线，保证组内只有一种对法。
en: Pick the display line as the reference, then rule its cap line, its baseline and the centre between them, running each across the whole layout.
Test the small line on each rule in turn, with one version per rule: cap to cap, baseline to baseline, centre to centre.
Compare the gaps the versions produce and settle on one; once settled, add no hand-typed spacing between the small and the display type.
Put every other small line in the group on the same rule, so the group uses one alignment and not several.

exercise.zh: 取一行大字和一行小字，在小字上分别试顶对齐、基线对齐、中线对齐三版，撤掉参考线后比一比，说得出哪一版最稳。
exercise.en: Take one display line and one small line, set the small line cap-aligned, baseline-aligned and centre-aligned, then remove the guides and judge which version holds best.

zh: 小字是否真的落在画出来的某一条线上，而不是两条线之间
定稿里是否没有任何手工加的空行或间距把落位顶偏
同一组的小字是否全部用同一条基准线
en: Does the small line sit on one of the drawn rules rather than between two of them?
Does the final contain no hand-typed gap or blank line pushing it off the rule?
Are all the small lines in the group using that same rule?

caution.zh: 顶对齐和基线对齐不能混用：一行顶对齐、一行基线对齐，两行会在视觉上错开半个字。小字字号改动后要重新核对一次落位，字号变了基线位置也跟着变。
caution.en: Never mix the two: a cap-aligned line next to a baseline-aligned one looks half a line out of place. And re-check the placement after any size change, since a new size moves the baseline with it.

prompt.zh: 请排一行大字加一段小字。先在版面上画出大字字面的顶线、基线和两者的中线，把这段小字分别按顶对齐、基线对齐、中线对齐各排一版，挑出间距观感最稳的一版作为定稿，并在定稿里只用这一条基准线，不额外加手工间距；其它小字沿用同一条线。
prompt.en: Set one large display line with a short small line beside it. Draw the display type's cap line, baseline and the centre between them, then set the small line cap-aligned, baseline-aligned and centre-aligned, one version each. Keep the version whose gap holds best, using that single rule in the final with no hand-added spacing, and put any other small line on the same rule.

zh: 整组尺寸由一个基数派生
en: One base size generates the whole group
dz: 主行定成基数，其余尺寸都是它的倍数或分数。
de: The main line becomes the base unit; every other size is a multiple or a fraction of it.
pz: 先定主行的字高 A，副行取 A×1.3，说明行取 A÷10，按钮高度取 A÷3；组里每个尺寸都是 A 的倍数或分数，不再各自另挑一个。
pe: Fix the main line's height as A. The secondary line takes A times 1.3, the caption A divided by 10, the button A divided by 3. Every size in the group is a multiple or a fraction of A instead of a fresh guess.

caption.zh: 组内每个尺寸都标着与基数的关系
caption.en: Every size in the group labelled against the base

observation.zh: 文字组里的每一行旁边都标着一个算式：A、A×1.3、A÷3、A÷10。它们不是各自挑来的字号，而是同一个基数 A 的倍数或分数，所以整组只有一处自由取值。相邻尺寸之间因此保持着固定倍率，改 A 的时候整组会一起等比变化。
observation.en: Each line in the group carries a formula beside it: A, A times 1.3, A divided by 3, A divided by 10. These are not separately chosen sizes but multiples and fractions of one base A, so the group contains a single free value. Adjacent steps therefore keep a fixed ratio, and changing A rescales the whole group at once.

zh: 先把内容按角色分行：主行、副行、说明行、按钮或标签，最多四档。
选行数最少、最重要的一行作为基数 A，量出或定下它的字高。
其余各档写成对 A 的算式（×1.3、÷3、÷10 之类），直接算出数值，不再逐个目测。
写下来贴在文件里；改动内容时只调 A，其余尺寸跟着重算。
en: Split the content into roles first: main line, secondary line, caption, button or tag, four steps at most.
Take the shortest, most important line as the base A and fix its height.
Write the other steps as formulas on A (times 1.3, divided by 3, divided by 10), compute them, and stop eyeballing each one.
Record the formulas in the file: when the content changes, adjust A only and recompute the rest.

exercise.zh: 拿一个四行的文字组，把主行定为 A，用三条算式（一个倍数、两个分数）推出其余三档，再和凭手感挑出来的版本比一次，看哪一组的倍率更整齐。
exercise.en: Take a four-line group, set the main line as A, and derive the other three steps from three formulas (one multiple, two fractions). Compare that with a version sized by eye and see which set of ratios holds together.

zh: 最大和最小两档是否都写成对 A 的算式，没有留一个凭感觉的数值
相邻两档之间是否保持稳定倍率，没有突然缩一截的档
改一次 A 之后，整组是否等比变化而不是局部错位
en: Are the largest and smallest steps both written as formulas on A, with no value left to taste?
Do neighbouring steps keep a steady ratio, with no step suddenly collapsing?
After changing A once, does the whole group rescale instead of drifting out of step?

caution.zh: 倍率别取得太密：三档之间相差不到两成，肉眼分不出来，层级就白做了；也别把算式写得太多，超过四五档之后组里会分不清主次。
caution.en: Do not crowd the ratio: three steps less than twenty per cent apart are indistinguishable and the hierarchy is wasted. And keep the set of formulas short; past four or five steps the group stops showing any order.

prompt.zh: 请排一个四行的文字组（主行、副行、说明行、按钮标签）。先定主行字高为 A，其余三档分别写成对 A 的倍数或分数算式（例如 ×1.3、÷3、÷10）并算出数值，不得各自单独取值；相邻档之间保持稳定倍率，视觉层级一眼可分。只输出定稿。
prompt.en: Lay out a four-line group (main line, secondary line, caption, button label). Fix the main line's height as A, then express the other three steps as multiples or fractions of A (say times 1.3, divided by 3, divided by 10) and compute them, with no size chosen on its own. Keep a steady ratio between neighbouring steps so the hierarchy reads at a glance. Output the final version only.

zh: 网格锁死，色块换格位
en: Lock the grid, move the blocks
dz: 反推出的网格不动，只把色块搬去别的格位。
de: The grid stays exactly where it was read off the reference; only the blocks move to other cells.
pz: 把成品版面的元素压成色块，读出它们落在哪几条网格线上；网格锁死后，只把色块搬到别的格位，得到新构成而版面不散。
pe: Reduce a finished layout to blocks and read which grid lines it actually sits on. Lock that grid, then move the blocks into other cells: a new composition that still holds together.

caption.zh: 网格不动，只把色块换到别的格位
caption.en: Same grid, blocks moved to other cells

observation.zh: 先把成品版面的标题、图片、说明、按钮全部压成灰色块，发现在没有文字和图片之后，这些块仍然落在几条固定的线上；把这几条线记下来锁死，再把块搬到别的格位，出来的画面是新的，但块与块的关系仍然是旧的那一套。
observation.en: Reduce a finished layout's headline, image, caption and button to grey blocks. With text and pictures gone, the blocks still land on a handful of fixed lines. Note those lines, lock them, then move the blocks into other cells: the image is new while the relationships between the blocks stay the ones that worked.

zh: 选一张自己认可的成品版面，把每个元素替换成同尺寸的色块，文字和图片都清掉。
沿着色块的边画出竖线与横线，只保留块真正靠着的那几条，得到模块网格。
把网格锁死，网格线不再移动；开始把色块搬到别的格位，格位可以空着。
排完后把内容填回色块，检查有没有元素仍然落在网格线上；偏出去的就拉回来。
en: Take a finished layout you trust and replace every element with a block of the same size, clearing out text and images.
Draw vertical and horizontal lines along the block edges, keep only the ones an edge actually rests on, and you have the module grid.
Lock the grid so its lines will not move, then move the blocks into other cells, leaving some cells empty.
Pour the content back into the blocks and check that every element still sits on a grid line; pull back anything that has drifted off.

exercise.zh: 取一张成品海报，先还原出它的网格（不超过六条线），再在不动网格的前提下把色块重新分配，做出一版完全不同的构成，最后填上自己的内容。
exercise.en: Take a finished poster, read out its grid in no more than six lines, then redistribute the blocks on that locked grid into a completely different composition and fill it with your own content.

zh: 网格线是否只有块真正靠着的那几条，没有多出来的装饰线
重排之后每个块是否仍落在网格线上，有没有斜跨半格的块
空白格位是否还成组成行，而不是零散的空隙
en: Does the grid contain only the lines block edges rest on, with no decorative extras?
After the reshuffle, does every block still sit on a grid line rather than straddling half a cell?
Do the empty cells still group into bands, instead of scattering as isolated gaps?

caution.zh: 先锁网格再搬块，顺序反了就会一路加线、最后没有网格可言；块搬得太碎（每个格位都放东西）会把反推出来的结构填平，宁可留空。
caution.en: Lock the grid before moving anything; reverse the order and you will keep adding lines until no grid is left. And do not fill every cell: a block in every slot flattens the very structure you just read out, so leave some cells empty.

prompt.zh: 请先选一张已完成的版面作为参照，把它的元素压成同尺寸的色块，沿块的边画出竖横网格线，只保留块真正靠着的那几条；随后锁死网格，把色块搬到别的格位（允许留空），得到一个全新的构成，再填入我提供的内容。要求每个块都仍落在网格线上，画面不散。
prompt.en: Take a finished layout as the reference and reduce its elements to same-size blocks. Draw vertical and horizontal grid lines along the block edges and keep only the lines that edges actually rest on. Then lock the grid, move the blocks into other cells, leaving some empty, to produce a new composition, and fill it with the content I supply. Every block must still land on a grid line and the layout must stay coherent.

zh: 标题两端齐，行高由字数反推
en: Flush both ends: size follows line length
dz: 四行标题的左右边界完全重合，行高随字数反比。
de: All four heading lines share one left and one right edge, so the longer line has to be set smaller.
pz: 先让最长的一行撑满栏宽，再把其余每行缩放到同宽；字数多的行自动变小，四行落在同一条左右边界上。
pe: Measure the longest line to fill the column, then scale every other line to the same width. The line with more characters ends up smaller, and all lines land on one identical pair of left and right edges.

caption.zh: 四行标题共用同一对左右边界
caption.en: Four heading lines on one pair of edges

observation.zh: 黑色大字是标题组，两条竖直参考线标出它们共用的一对左右边界；两行宽度一模一样，但拉丁那行明显矮一截，中文两行也各自缩到同一宽度。
observation.en: Two vertical guides mark the left and right edge the heading lines share. The Latin line is visibly shorter than the one above it, and the two Chinese lines each scale down to that same width.

zh: 数出标题组每一行的字数，找出最长的那一行。
把最长行放到栏宽上，只调它的字号，直到左右两端同时顶满。
其余每一行按「栏宽除以该行字数」估一个字号，再微调到两端也贴住同两条线。
通看一遍：把所有行的左端连起来、右端连起来，应该各是一条直线。
en: Count the characters in each heading line and find the longest one.
Set that line to the column width, changing only its size until both ends touch.
Estimate each remaining line as column width divided by its character count, then nudge it until both ends land on the same two lines.
Read it back: the left ends should form one straight line and the right ends another.

exercise.zh: 写两到四行英文短句，字数故意差一倍，用同一栏宽把每一行都缩到两端齐。
exercise.en: Write two to four short English lines whose lengths differ by a factor of two, then scale each one to touch both edges of the same column.

zh: 是否每一行的左右两端都落在同两条线上
字数最多的那行是否最大，而不是反过来
en: Do all the lines land on the same two edges?
Is the line with the most characters the largest, not the other way round?

caution.zh: 两端齐只适合两三行的展示级标题。正文和长句这么做会把字距拉得没法读。
caution.en: Flush-both-ends is for display headings of two or three lines. Doing it to body copy or long sentences stretches the spacing past readability.

prompt.zh: 做一张只有标题组的版式：给出两到四行英文短句，字数故意拉开，让每一行都撑满同一条左右边界，也就是每行的字号由栏宽除以该行字数决定。所有行的左端连成一条直线，右端也连成一条直线，行内字距保持正常不要拉伸。背景浅米色，字色深墨绿，画面里除了这组标题什么都不放。
prompt.en: Build a layout containing only a heading group: two to four short English lines of deliberately different lengths, each scaled to fill the same left and right edge, so every line's size is the column width divided by its character count. Left ends form one straight line and right ends another, and the letter spacing inside each line stays normal, never stretched. Pale cream background, dark ink-green type, nothing else on the page.

zh: 正文折行宽度，跟着标题最宽行
en: The widest title line sets the body measure
dz: 标题最宽的一行正好等于栏宽，正文在同一宽度里折行。
de: The widest heading line is made to equal the column width; the body paragraph then breaks inside that same width.
pz: 三行标题左齐，其中最长的一行正好撑满栏宽；正文段落以同一条左边界起排，折行的右界也止于那条线，标题和正文共用同一个 measure。
pe: Three heading lines sit flush left and the longest of them exactly fills the column. The body starts on the same left edge and its ragged-right wrap stops at that same line, so heading and body share a single measure.

caption.zh: 标题最宽行定栏宽，正文照此折行
caption.en: The widest heading line gives the measure

observation.zh: 两条竖直参考线夹住标题组，最长的那行正好顶满；正文段落的第一行也从同一条左边界起排，最后一行在右边界内断开。
observation.en: Two vertical guides bracket the heading and its longest line touches both. The body paragraph starts on the same left edge and its lines break inside that right edge.

zh: 先把全部文字倒在同一个宽度里排一遍，找出标题里最长的一行。
调标题字号，让这一行正好撑满那条宽度，其余标题行左对齐、右端自然参差。
把正文放进同一个宽度，左边界与标题完全相同。
检查正文最长的一行是否还留有余量，若顶到边界就把正文字号降一档。
en: Set all the text in one width first and find the longest heading line.
Size the heading so that line fills that width; the other heading lines stay flush left with a ragged right.
Place the body in the same width, sharing the heading's left edge exactly.
Check that the longest body line still has slack; if it touches the edge, drop the body one size step.

exercise.zh: 给一段三行标题配一段三行说明，让两者共用同一个宽度：标题最宽行顶满，正文在同样的左右边界里折行。
exercise.en: Take a three-line heading and a three-line note and give them one shared width: the widest heading line fills it, and the note wraps inside the same two edges.

zh: 标题最宽行是否正好等于栏宽，既不留空也不超出
正文左边界是否与标题左边界完全重合
en: Does the widest heading line equal the column exactly, with neither a gap nor an overflow?
Does the body's left edge coincide with the heading's?

caution.zh: 宽度由标题定，不代表正文可以顶格。正文每行末尾要留出一点余量，否则读者会以为还有下文。
caution.en: The heading sets the measure, but that does not mean the body should run edge to edge. Leave a little slack at the end of every body line or readers will assume more text follows.

prompt.zh: 排一页只有标题与一段说明的版式：标题三行，左齐右参差，其中最长的一行正好撑满栏宽；下面一段三到四行的说明文字，左边界与标题完全相同，右边界也在同一条线上折行，行尾参差。标题字号与正文字号至少差三档，背景浅米色，字色深墨绿，不加任何线条或色块。
prompt.en: Lay out a page holding only a heading and one paragraph. The heading runs three lines, flush left with a ragged right, and its longest line exactly fills the column. The note below wraps inside the very same left and right edges with a ragged right. Keep at least three size steps between heading and note. Pale cream background, dark ink-green type, no rules and no colour blocks.

zh: 行距四等分，当最小纵向网格
en: Quarter the leading as the smallest grid step
dz: 一行行距切成四格，所有纵向位置都落在这格上。
de: One leading divides into four equal bands, and every vertical position snaps to that smallest band.
pz: 在一行行距的上下各画一条线，中间再等分三条，把它切成四格；下一行、下一组字、下一条分隔线的位置都吸到这四格上。
pe: Draw a line at the top and bottom of one leading, then divide the space between them into four equal bands. The next line, the next text group, the next rule: every vertical position snaps to one of those four steps.

caption.zh: 五条细线，把一行行距切成四格
caption.en: Five hairlines cut one leading into four

observation.zh: 两条基线的距离被五条细线等分成四格，每格只有行距的四分之一；下一行、下一个字组、下一条分隔线都落在某一格线上，而不是随手留白。
observation.en: Five hairlines divide the distance between two baselines into four equal bands a quarter of the leading wide. The next line, the next group and the next rule all land on one of those band lines instead of on an arbitrary gap.

zh: 先定正文字号，把行距设成字号的一个固定倍数，这个行距就是你的大格。
把大格四等分，得到最小的纵向单位。
让每一处纵向间距都取大格的整数倍，格内的位置取四分之一格。
最后把分隔线与分组间距全部对齐到格线，删掉落在格线之间的零散间距。
en: Fix the body size, then set the leading to a fixed multiple of it. That leading is your large step.
Quarter the large step; that is the smallest vertical unit.
Make every vertical gap a whole number of large steps, with positions inside a step taken in quarters.
Snap rules and group gaps onto those grid lines and delete the stray gaps that fall between them.

exercise.zh: 找一段现成的两行文字，量出它的行距，在上下各画一条线并四等分，再把页面里所有纵向间距改成整格或四分之一格。
exercise.en: Take two existing lines of text, measure the leading, draw a line at each end and quarter it, then reset every vertical gap on the page to whole steps or quarters.

zh: 最小纵向单位是否等于行距的四分之一
是否还有落在格线之间的间距
en: Does the smallest vertical unit equal a quarter of the leading?
Are there any gaps left sitting between grid lines?

caution.zh: 格子太细等于没有格子。四等分只对正文行距成立；标题那种大字要另设一个更大的倍数，否则整页格子会密到失去意义。
caution.en: A grid finer than the eye can hold is no grid. Quartering works for body leading; large display type needs a bigger multiple, or the whole page grid becomes too dense to mean anything.

prompt.zh: 做一张只有文字的版式，用一套纵向网格控制全部间距：先定正文字号与行距，把行距四等分成最小单位；页面里每组文字之间、每条分隔线与上下文的距离，都取行距的整数倍，组内微调取四分之一格。左边界统一一条线，背景浅米色，字色深墨绿，只用一条细线和一组页码级的小字陪衬。
prompt.en: Make an all-type layout governed by one vertical grid. Fix the body size and leading, then quarter the leading as the smallest unit. Every gap between groups, and every rule's distance from the text above and below, is a whole number of leadings, with quarter-step adjustments inside a group. One shared left edge, pale cream background, dark ink-green type, one hairline and one folio-level line as company.

zh: 小字组总高，对齐大字字面高
en: A small group totals the big face height
dz: 旁边两行小字的高，正好等于大字的字面高度。
de: The two small lines beside the display word measure exactly the same height as its face.
pz: 大字放左边，两行小字放右边；调小字的字号与行距，让两行小字的总高（含行距）等于大字的字面高，上下边界重合，两级字看着是一块。
pe: The display word sits on the left, two small lines on the right. Tune the small pair's size and leading until their total height equals the display word's cap height, so both share the top and bottom edge and the two levels read as one block.

caption.zh: 两行小字的总高等于大字的字面高
caption.en: Two small lines total the big cap height

observation.zh: 上下两条水平参考线，一条压在大字字面的顶端，一条压在大字的基线上；右边两行小字正好填满这两条线之间，既不出头也不塌下去。
observation.en: Two horizontal guides run across the block, one at the top of the display word's face and one on its baseline. The two small lines on the right fill exactly that band, neither overshooting nor sagging.

zh: 量出大字从字面顶端到基线的字面高度。
把小字组的字号与行距当作两个旋钮，先定字号，再调行距。
让两行小字的总高（首行字面顶端到末行基线）等于大字的字面高。
把整组压在大字旁边，上下两端与大字对齐，通看是否成为一条横带。
en: Measure the display word's cap height, from the top of its face to its baseline.
Treat the small group's size and leading as two knobs: set the size first, then the leading.
Make the pair's total height, from the first line's cap top to the last line's baseline, equal that cap height.
Sit the group beside the display word with both ends aligned, then check that the whole thing reads as one horizontal band.

exercise.zh: 写一个四字母的大词，旁边配两行小字说明，把两行小字的总高调到与大词的字面高完全相等。
exercise.en: Take a four-letter display word, set two lines of small copy beside it, and tune the pair's total height until it equals the display word's cap height exactly.

zh: 小字首行的字面顶端是否与大字字面顶端同高
小字末行的基线是否与大字基线同高
en: Does the first small line's cap top sit level with the display word's?
Does the last small line's baseline sit level with the display word's?

caution.zh: 对齐的是字面高度，不是字号。大字的字面高只有字号的三分之二上下，小字若按同字号去配，两行一定冒头。
caution.en: You are matching face heights, not font sizes. A display word's cap height is only about two thirds of its size, so small type set at a matching size will always overshoot.

prompt.zh: 做一个只有两级文字的版式：左边一个四到六个字母的大写词，字面高度占画布高度的三分之一左右；右边两行小字，字号约等于大词的三分之一，行距调到让这两行的总高（首行字面顶端到最后一行基线）与大词的字面高完全相等，两级文字的上下边界各自连成一条直线。背景浅米色，字色深墨绿，不加线条与色块。
prompt.en: Make a layout with exactly two levels of type: a four to six letter uppercase word on the left whose cap height is about a third of the canvas height, and two small lines on the right at roughly a third of that size. Tune the leading so the pair's total height, from the first line's cap top to the last line's baseline, equals the display word's cap height exactly, with both levels' tops and bottoms forming straight lines. Pale cream background, dark ink-green type, no rules and no blocks.

zh: 标题字面拉三线，小字入带
en: Three rules off the title, every block banded
dz: 主标题的字面框拉出三条线，全版其余信息分成上下两条带，各自贴线。
de: Rules are pulled off the headline's face box, and every other block on the page drops into one of the two bands between them.
pz: 先量主标题字面高，用字面顶、中线、基线三条通栏线把它二等分；其余文字按带高选档，嵌进对应的带，上下贴线。带高一致，全版小字只有两档。
pe: Measure the headline's face height, then halve it with three full-width rules: face top, midline, baseline. Every other block picks a size from its band and sits flush to both rules, so equal bands leave the page with two small-type sizes.

caption.zh: 三条线把标题字面二等分
caption.en: Three rules halve the headline face

observation.zh: 大标题的上下两端各压一条通栏线，中间再加一条把字面等分的线；右侧两条带里各装一段小字，字面顶到上下两条线。
observation.en: One full-width rule pins the top of the big headline, another pins its baseline, and a third cuts the face in half between them. To the right, one small block sits in each band, its face touching both rules.

zh: 量出主标题字面的高度，从上边、中间、下边各拉一条通栏线。
把两条带分给次级信息：三行说明装进上面那条，单行拉丁字装进下面那条。
调每段小字的字号，让字面高度等于带高，越线或悬空都算没对齐。
再从版心左边界拉竖线，各段起点贴线，行与列同时对齐。
en: Measure the headline's face height and pull a full-width rule at its top, its middle and its baseline.
Give the two bands to the secondary text: a three-line note into the upper band, a single Latin line into the lower one.
Set each block's size until its face equals the band height; crossing the rule above or floating below is not aligned.
Pull vertical rules off the left margin so every block starts on one line, rows and columns aligned together.

exercise.zh: 拿一句大标题拉出三条线，把一段三行说明和一行拉丁小字分别装进两条带，字面顶满带高。
exercise.en: Take one headline, pull three rules off its face, then fit a three-line note and one Latin line into the two bands at full band height.

zh: 两条带里的小字是否都上下贴线，没有越线或悬空
两条带的高度是否完全相等
en: Does every block in the bands touch both rules, with nothing crossing or floating?
Are the two bands exactly the same height?

caution.zh: 带高定了就别用字距去凑字号，差一点也只能换档；标题自己没压在那两条线上，整版都是歪的。
caution.en: Once the bands are set, never fake a size with tracking, change the step instead. If the headline itself misses its two rules, the whole page drifts.

prompt.zh: 做一张只有标题和两段小字的版式：先用字面顶、中线、基线三条通栏线把标题字面二等分，再把一段三行小字和一行拉丁小字分别装进这两条带，字面顶满带高、上下都贴线。标题和两段小字共用同一条左边界和同一条右边界，背景浅米色，字色深墨绿。
prompt.en: Build a layout with one headline and two small blocks: pull three full-width rules at the headline's face top, midline and baseline to halve it, then fit a three-line note and one Latin line into those two bands, each at full band height and flush to the rules. Headline and both blocks share one left edge and one right edge. Pale cream ground, dark ink-green type.

zh: 圈字当字标，取自标题
en: A circled headline glyph leads the block
dz: 从标题里挑一个字，套上圆圈，放在说明段左侧当字标，圆径与段落等高。
de: Pick one glyph out of the headline, set it in a circle and let that circle lead a paragraph, sizing it to the block's height.
pz: 从标题组里摘一个汉字套进圆，圆径按它标记的段落高度定：单行段用小圆，三行段用大圆；圆与段落共用一条左边界，字面撑满圆。全版这种字标不超过两个。
pe: Lift a glyph out of the headline, wrap it in a circle and let it lead a paragraph. Its diameter follows the block it marks, small circle for one line and large for three, and the circle shares the paragraph's left edge. Two marks per page at most.

caption.zh: 圆圈里的字替段落开路
caption.en: A circled glyph opens the paragraph

observation.zh: 三段小字左边站着一个圆圈，圈里的字是从大标题里摘出来的；圆的外径和三行小字的总高一样，圆与文字共用同一条左边界。第二个字标同理，换标题里的另一个字。
observation.en: A circle stands left of each small block, holding a glyph lifted from the big headline. Its outer diameter matches the block's total height, and circle and text share one left edge. The second mark works the same way with another glyph.

zh: 在标题里挑出与这段说明对应的那个字，摘出来单独放。
按段落高度定圆径：一行字用小圆，三行字用大圆。
把圆的左边界对齐段落的左边界，圆与文字之间留一个行距。
字放进圆里，字面撑满内径，居中放。
全版只留两处，多了就不叫字标了。
en: Pick the glyph in the headline that answers this paragraph and pull it out.
Set the diameter from the block's height: small circle for one line, large for three.
Align the circle's left edge with the block's left edge, leaving one line space between circle and text.
Drop the glyph in so its face fills the inner diameter, centred.
Keep two of these on the page; more stops being a mark.

exercise.zh: 写一段三行说明，从标题里摘一个字做成圆圈字标放在段首，圆径对齐段高。
exercise.en: Write a three-line note, lift one glyph from the headline into a circle at its head, and set the diameter to the block's height.

zh: 圆径是否等于所标段落的总高
圆与段落是否共用一条左边界
en: Does the diameter equal the height of the block it marks?
Do the circle and the block share one left edge?

caution.zh: 圆圈是标点不是插图，一版最多两个；圈里的字必须真的出现在标题里，随手找字就断了对应关系。
caution.en: The circle is punctuation, not illustration, so two per page at most. And the glyph must really appear in the headline, or the link breaks.

prompt.zh: 做一张带两段说明的版式：各从大标题里摘一个字，套进圆圈当段首字标，圆径分别等于所标段落的总高，圆的左边界与段落左边界对齐，字面撑满圆的内径并居中。标题在版面上方，两个字标各领一段说明，背景浅米色，字色深墨绿。
prompt.en: Build a page with two note blocks: lift one glyph from the headline into a circle at the head of each, the diameter equal to that block's height, the circle's left edge on the block's left edge, and the glyph filling the inner diameter, centred. The headline sits above; two marks lead two notes. Pale cream ground, dark ink-green type.

zh: 字号从行高除出来，只取整数档
en: Every size is row height over a whole number
dz: 字号不是挑的，是行高除以整数得来的：标题占半行，小字三行占一行。
de: Sizes are not chosen but divided out of the row height: the headline takes half a row, and small type fits three lines into one row.
pz: 定好行高后只做除法：标题取行高一半，小字取三分之一，其余档位同理。字面要卡满切出来的带，上不越线、下不留空；三行小字的字面总高正好等于一个行高。
pe: Once the row height is fixed, sizes are pure division: headline a half row, small type a third, other levels the same. Each face must fill the band it was cut for, touching both rules, so three lines of small type add up to exactly one row.

caption.zh: 一个大一个小，都从行高除出来
caption.en: Two sizes, both divided out of the row

observation.zh: 横向的参考线先划出等高的行，再在行里加一条把行高对半切开的线；标题的字面正好卡满上半条带。另一行里排三行小字，三行的字面高度加起来正好是一个行高。
observation.en: Horizontal rules cut the page into equal rows, then one more line bisects a row. The headline's face fills the upper half exactly. In another row three lines of small type stack so their faces add up to one full row.

zh: 先定行高，把它当成全版唯一的量纲，行线拉通栏。
标题取行高二分之一：字号定到字面正好卡满切出来的半行带。
小字取行高三分之一：三行的字面高度加起来正好等于一条行高。
需要更多档位就继续除，四分之一、五分之一同理，不做任意值。
复查每条带的上下边，字面越线或留空都要重新调档。
en: Fix the row height first and treat it as the page's only unit, drawing the row rules across.
The headline takes half a row: set its size until the face fills the bisected band.
Small type takes a third of a row: three lines of it add up to exactly one row height.
For more steps keep dividing, a quarter, a fifth, never an arbitrary value.
Recheck every band top and bottom; a face crossing a rule or leaving a gap means the step is wrong.

exercise.zh: 定一条行高，用一半和三分之一两个档位排一行标题加三行小字，全部对齐行线。
exercise.en: Fix one row height, then set a headline at half a row and three small lines at a third, all locked to the row rules.

zh: 标题字面是否正好卡满半行带
三行小字加起来是否正好一个行高
en: Does the headline's face fill the half-row band exactly?
Do the three small lines add up to exactly one row height?

caution.zh: 档位只能来自行高，先有字号再去找行高就变成凑数，版面上会出现对不上的零点几行。
caution.en: The steps must come out of the row height. Picking a size first and hunting for a row to match it leaves fractions of a row that never line up.

prompt.zh: 做一张网格版式：先定一条通栏的行高，把行高对半切开，标题字号定到字面正好卡满上半条带；再用三分之一个行高排三行小字，让三行的字面高度加起来正好等于一个行高。所有字面的上下边都贴住行线，不越线不留空。背景浅米色，字色深墨绿，别用除不尽的字号。
prompt.en: Build a grid layout: fix one full-width row height, bisect it, and set the headline so its face fills the upper band exactly. Then set three small lines at a third of the row height each, so the three faces add up to exactly one row. Every face sits on the row rules, crossing nothing and leaving no gap. Pale cream ground, dark ink-green type, no sizes that do not divide evenly.

zh: 小字柱拉字距，跟大字柱等高
en: Small column tracks out to match the tall one
dz: 同一行里各柱字的上下各贴一条线，字小的那柱靠拉字距撑到与大字柱等高。
de: Columns in a row share one top rule and one bottom rule; the small-type column reaches that height only by opening its letter spacing.
pz: 先把两柱的上下两条界线拉平：大字柱字面本就近等高，小字柱差多少按行数摊进字距。判断标准是两柱顶端、底端各成一条直线，小字柱在栏线之间看得出疏密差别。
pe: Level the top and bottom rules of two columns. The large-type column nearly fills the height; the small one makes up the rest by spreading it across its lines as letter spacing. Both tops form one line, both bottoms another, small column looser.

caption.zh: 小字柱被字距撑到等高
caption.en: Letter spacing lifts the small column

observation.zh: 同一行里并排两柱字，字大的那柱只有五个字，字小的那柱有八行；两柱的顶端和底端各贴住同一条通栏线，小字柱每行之间的空明显比大字柱大。
observation.en: Two columns stand side by side in one row, the large-type one shorter in line count than the small one. Both tops and both bottoms touch the same pair of rules, and the small column's spaces between lines are clearly wider.

zh: 先拉两条通栏线，定出这一行的高度，两柱都按它对齐。
大字柱按行数排满，行距保持正常，让它自然接近这条高度。
小字柱排完后量出与目标高度的差，按行数一摊，全部加进字距。
补两条竖栏线夹住小字柱，检查拉开的字距是否均匀。
两柱顶端连成一条直线、底端连成一条直线，才算对平。
en: Pull two full-width rules to fix the row height and align both columns to it.
Set the large-type column at normal spacing so it naturally comes close to that height.
Set the small column, measure what is missing against the target height and spread it evenly into the letter spacing.
Add two vertical column rules around the small column and check the opened spacing is even.
Only when both tops form one line and both bottoms another are the columns levelled.

exercise.zh: 并排排两柱字，一柱大字一柱小字，只用字距把小字柱拉到与大字柱等高，上下贴同两条线。
exercise.en: Set two columns side by side, one large and one small, and use letter spacing alone to lift the small one to the same height, flush to the same two rules.

zh: 两柱的顶端和底端是否各连成一条直线
小字柱的字距拉开后是否仍然均匀、读得下去
en: Do the two tops form one line and the two bottoms another?
Is the small column's opened spacing still even and readable?

caution.zh: 差得太远就别硬拉，缺半行以上时字距会散成两截，宁可换柱宽或减行数。
caution.en: Do not force it when the gap is large: past half a row the tracking splits the column into two clumps. Change the column width or drop a line instead.

prompt.zh: 做一张两柱并排的版式：先拉两条通栏线定出这一行的高度，左柱排大字、右柱排小字，两柱顶端和底端各贴同一条线。只允许用字距把小字柱拉到与大字柱等高，行距和字号都不要动；再补两条竖栏线夹住小字柱，让拉开的字距看得出来。背景浅米色，字色深墨绿。
prompt.en: Build a page with two columns side by side: pull two full-width rules to fix the row height, set large type in the left column and small type in the right, both tops and both bottoms touching the same rules. Letter spacing is the only tool allowed to lift the small column to the same height; leave line spacing and sizes untouched. Add two vertical column rules around the small column so the opened spacing shows. Pale cream ground, dark ink-green type.
